name: The Brute
text: When aced to cover casualties in a shootout, reduce the remaining casualties you must cover by 2.

name: Smiling Tom
text: Tom can only move to your home or to a location that has another Fourth Ring dude.

name: Philip Swinford
text: Each time an opposing player reveals an illegal draw hand and you do not, you may draw a card then discard a card.

name: Drew Beauman
text: Each time a player reveals an illegal draw hand and you do not, Drew may immediately attempt to invent a Gadget without booting (other requirements of inventing must still be met).

name: Dr. Arden Gillman
text: Shootout Boot: Arden makes a mad scientist skill check against an opposing dude's grit. If successful, send that dude home booted. If successful by 6 or more, ace the dude. If the pull is a spade or a joker, Arden suffers the same fate.

name: Arvid Mardh
text: React: After Arvid enters play, make a tradin' Noon play.

name: Allie Hensman
text: Noon Job, Boot: Allie leads a job that marks an opposing dude. If successful, the mark's controller must give you ghost rock equal to the mark's influence. If the player cannot or does not, discard the mark.

name: Milt Clemons
text: Whenever Milt's bounty increases, gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Jake Smiley
text: Jake has +2 Influence during the Sundown phase.

name: QUATERMAN
text: Quaterman must be invented by a Mad Scientist like any other gadget. It enters play at the Mad Scientist's location (but does not attach). Quaterman's bullets cannot be modified except by attached goods. Cards cannot move or boot Quaterman.

name: Angela Payne
text: Noon, Boot: If Angela is at a deed you do not own, gain 2 ghost rock.

name: The Mayor's Office
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Raise or lower the influence of a dude at this or an adjacent location by 1.

name: Hunter Protections
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Boot your dude without a control point at this location. Raise their bounty by 2. They permanently get 1 control point.

name: The Evidence
text: Noon: Reduce a wanted dude's bounty to 0. Discard this card.  Noon, Pay 1 Ghost Rock: Raise the bounty on a dude by 2. Ace this card.

name: Teleportation Device
text: After this gadget is invented, attach it to a deed that you control.  Repeat Noon, Pay 1 Ghost Rock: Choose your dude at this location and pull. If the pull is a club, discard the dude. Otherwise, move your dude to another location (without booting).

name: Mayfair Family Deck
text: This dude has Huckster: 0. If this card leaves this dude, discard all Hexes from this dude.

name: Puppet
text: Noon Hex X, Boot: X is the grit of a dude at this location. Take control of the dude until after the Sundown phase.

name: Summoning
text: Noon Hex 5: If successful, mark the town square for a job. If the job succeeds, immediately play an Abomination from your hand reducing its cost by 6 ghost rock (paying all other costs). The Abomination permanently gains 1 control point.

name: Ridden Down
text: Noon: Boot your Horse to send a dude without a Horse at this location home booted.

name: Tail Between Yer Legs
text: React: After your call-out is accepted, the mark must form their posse before you form yours. The mark has -2 bullets.

name: Election Day Slaughter
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark the town square. Each other player may unboot a dude in town. If successful, each other player must ace one of their dudes in town.

name: Yasmin Tian
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, you may discard a card to draw a card.

name: Dynamite Jacc
text: Resolution, Boot: Ace Jacc to make the opposing posse suffer 2 extra casualties.

name: Bai Yang Chen (Exp.1)
text: Bai Yang Chen cannot have attachments.  While Bai Yang Chen is in a posse, after each shootout play (including passing), remove any modifiers to his bullet rating, set it to 5, and then reduce it by 1 for each card in your hand.  Noon: If you have no ghost rock in your stash, draw a card.

name: Huang Li
text: After using Huang Li's Shootout ability: • if you booted a Blessed dude, unboot another dude in the shootout. • if you booted an Abomination, Huang Li gets +2 bullets. • if you booted a Kung Fu dude, boot an opposing dude.  Shootout: Boot your dude (in this shootout) to discard a card and draw a card.

name: Arthur Dingler
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may discard them, shuffle them into your deck, or return them to your deck in the same order. Take 1 ghost rock from the bank and add it to the pot for the Gamblin' phase.

name: Deadwood Dick
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Boot Dick or his Horse to send any number of your dudes with Horses home booted. If your hand is legal, those dudes do not boot.

name: Al Swearengen
text: Noon, Pay 4 Ghost Rock: Al permanently has +1 bullets, +1 influence, is a stud, and loses this ability.

name: Aunt Lou Marchbanks
text: While at a location you own, Aunt Lou is a stud.

name: Lew Esquilin
text: React, Boot At the start of the game, look at the top 6 cards of your deck. You may discard a card from your hand to reveal an Abomination or non-Unique Mystical goods and add it to your play hand. Return the other cards in your deck in the same order.

name: Mourning Mist
text: Noon, Boot: Ace Mourning Mist to boot a dude at this or an adjacent location.

name: Victor Nines de Boré
text: Victor has a bonus to his Huckster skill equal to the number of Abominations at his location. This bonus cannot exceed +4.

name: The Angler
text: Noon: The Angler calls out a dude at his location who has the same value.  Noon: Discard a card to change The Angler's value to that card's value.

name: Sifting Squirrel
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, you may draw a card and then discard a card. If you discard a Spirit or Technique, draw a card.

name: Lewis Grizzly Evans
text: While there are no Weapons in the opposing posse, Lewis is a stud.  While there is another dude in your posse, Lewis has \Shootout, Boot:\ Choose and boot an opposing dude with a lower value. Neither dude contributes to draw hands unless they are the only dude in their posse.\

name: Professor Duncan (Exp.1)
text: While at a location with a Totem, Duncan is a stud.  React: After you play a Totem at Duncan's location, draw a card if it is the only Totem with that name at that location.

name: Yiska
text: While Yiska has a Sidekick, he has +2 bullets.

name: Dr. JT Goodenough
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, search your deck for two different non-Unique Gadget Weapons and reveal them. Your opponent chooses one to discard. Attach the other to one of your dudes, paying its ghost rock cost (without inventing). Discard a card.

name: Seth Bullock
text: While your draw hand is cheatin', Seth lowers your hand rank by his bullet rating if he is in your posse.  React: After you use a Cheatin' Resolution ability on an action card, unboot Seth.

name: Clint Ramsey
text: Repeat React: After your opponent reveals a cheatin' hand, unboot Clint.

name: Mimi The Nun O'Brien
text: React Before you take casualties, if Mimi is in your posse you may discard a Miracle from your hand to suffer 1 fewer casualties this round. If your hand is legal, you suffer 2 fewer casualties instead.

name: Sam Bass
text: While Sam is in your posse, Cheatin' Resolution abilities on action cards cost +1 ghost rock.

name: Rosaleen Byrne
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, discard 2 cards from your hand to draw 2 cards.

name: Jack McCall
text: Shootout: If there are more dudes in your posse than in the opposing posse, give Jack 1 bounty to make him a stud.

name: Reggie Mallard
text: Reggie has a bullet bonus equal to the number of Hucksters in his posse. This bonus cannot exceed +4.

name: Alferd Packer
text: While Alferd is in your posse, your opponent gains \Repeat Shootout, Pay 3 Ghost Rock: Alferd joins your posse, under y0our control.\

name: John Aces Radcliffe (Exp.1)
text: While John has a Gadget Weapon, he is a stud. John cannot trade away his goods.  React: After John enters play, attach a Gadget Weapon from your hand or discard pile to him, paying its ghost rock cost (without inventing). If the Gadget comes from your hand, reduce its cost to 0.

name: Willa Mae MacGowan (Exp.1)
text: Resolution: Discard Willa Mae to send a dude in your posse home. If your opponent's hand is cheatin', unboot that dude.

name: New Varney Nosferatu
text: If the New Varney Nosferatu is in a Public location at the beginning of High Noon, send it home booted.

name: Carmichael's Livery
text: This deed has +1 production and +1 control points if there is a Horse at this deed.

name: Land Purchase
text: Controller Noon Job, Boot: Mark this deed. If successful, discard this deed to choose a deed in your discard pile and play it, reducing its cost by 3.

name: Heath's Curiosity Shoppe
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Discard 2 cards. Choose a non-Unique card in your discard pile that matches the suit of one of the discarded cards and the value of the other discarded card, and put it into your hand.

name: The Gem Theater
text: Controller Shootout, Boot: If the shootout is at this deed, each dude in the shootout becomes a draw.

name: Baird's Debt Collections
text: Each time a deed is played, gain 1 ghost rock.  Controller Noon, Boot: Discard a card from your hand to boot a deed.

name: Cheyenne Club
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Choose a dude at this or an adjacent location. That dude has +1 to each of their skill ratings (the skills are Mad Scientist, Blessed, Huckster, and Shaman).

name: Nuttal & Mann's No. 10 Saloon
text: Controller Noon/Shootout, Boot, Pay 1 ghost rock: Boot or unboot a dude at this deed.

name: Winner's Circle Auction House
text: This deed has +1 control points for each player with a dude at this deed.

name: Feathered Friend
text: Noon, Boot: Choose a dude at this location. Look at a random card in their controller's hand.  Shootout, Boot: Look at a random card in your opponent's hand.

name: Bulletproof Vest
text: This dude may not boot to join a posse at an adjacent location.  Resolution, Boot: Discard a card from your hand to have your posse suffer 1 fewer casualties this round.

name: Pale Horse
text: Cheatin' Resolution, Boot: You may send an opposing dude without a Horse home booted. If your hand is legal, you suffer X fewer casualties this round, where X is this dude's bullet rating.

name: Kinetic Accretion Actualizer
text: Repeat Shootout: Kinetic Accretion Actualizer has an additional +1 bullets until Sundown. You may use this ability once per shootout round.

name: Missed Me!
text: Cheatin' Resolution Hex 5, Boot: Reduce your opponent's hand rank by the total number of Sidekicks and dudes in their posse, to a maximum of 4.

name: Mark of War
text: Noon Hex 7, Boot: This dude's call outs cannot be refused. Discard this Hex.

name: We Stand Amazed
text: React Miracle X, Boot: When a dude in this shootout is being discarded as a casualty, send that dude home booted instead. X is that dude's grit.

name: Benediction
text: Noon Miracle 6: Choose another dude at this or an adjacent location. That dude has +2 to each of their skill ratings (the skills are Huckster, Blessed, Shaman, and Mad Scientist). If they do not have a skill, this dude has +1 bullets.

name: Guiding the Pack
text: Shootout Spirit 5, Boot: If there are more dudes in your posse than the opposing posse, boot an opposing card. If you succeed by 4 or more, choose one of your dudes. That dude has + bullets.

name: Elk's Protection
text: Can only attach to a deed.  Noon Spirit 8, Boot: Choose a dude without a Weapon. That dude has +X bullets. X is this deed's printed production.  Shootout Spirit 8, Boot: Choose a dude without a We3apon. That dude has +X bullets. X is this deed's printed production.

name: Get Off My Land!
text: React: After an opposing dude moves to a deed you own, move your dude to that deed from an adjacent location. This card's ghost rock cost is equal to the opposing dude's influence.

name: Look What I Found!
text: Shootout: Choose a non-Unique Weapon in your discard pile and attach it to a dude in your posse, paying all costs. Boot a Weapon or Sidekick attached to that dude.

name: Mantis Pinch
text: Noon Technique: Choose a printed ability on a card at this location. That ability cannot be used.  Shootout Technique: Choose a printed ability on a card at this shootout. That ability cannot be used until after Sundown.

name: As Nature and God Intended
text: Shootout: All Weapons lose their bullet bonuses, traits, and Shootout abilities until the end of this round of the shootout. Dudes with Kung Fu are studs until the end of this round of the shootout.

name: Play for Blood
text: Resolution: If draw hand ranks are tied, increase your draw hand rank by 1.  Noon: Draw a card and discard a card.

name: Bad Beat
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Discard the cheatin' player's draw hand and replace it with the top five cards of their deck. If the replacement draw hand is cheatin', take up to 2 ghost rock from that player.

name: Fallen Star
text: React: After your dude is chosen by an opponent's Shootout ability, boot a dude in your posse that could have been chosen. The booted dude is chosen instead.

name: Masonic Augment
text: Noon/Shootout: Discard a spell you own and control to choose one of your dudes. That dude has +1 bullets and +1 influence. If the spell was unbooted, gain ghost rock equal to the spell's printed cost.

name: Swagger
text: Noon: Move your unbooted dude to an adjacent location. That dude has +1 influence for controlling deeds until the end of the next Upkeep phase.

name: Vamoosin'
text: Shootout: Send a wanted dude home. This card's ghost rock cost is equal to the wanted dude's influence.

name: Seamus McCaffrey
text: While you have dudes in five or more different locations, reduce other players' control point totals by 2.

name: Shi Long Peng
text: Shi Long can use Techniques as if he had Kung Fu equal to his Blessed skill.

name: Gene North Star
text: Shootout: Discard a Spirit attached to Gene to give him +2 bullets.

name: Speaks-with-Earth
text: React, Boot: After an opposing dude moves to this location, boot that dude. You may unboot a Totem at this location, and its abilities may be used an additional time this turn.

name: The Grey Man
text: Noon: Choose a dude at this location whose value is equal to or lower than  The Grey Man's bullets. Send that dude home booted.

name: Erin Knight
text: Repeat Shootout: Boot one of your Deputies to have them join Erin's posse (moving if necessary).

name: Nicholas Kramer
text: Nicholas has a bullet bonus equal to the number of Gadgets you control. This bonus cannot exceed +4.

name: Quimby R. Tuttlemeir
text: Noon: Ace an Abomination with 1 or more influence that you own and control at this or an adjacent location. Quimby permanently gains 1 influence.

name: Pancho Castillo
text: React: When Pancho enters play, move 1 bounty from each of your Wanted dudes to Pancho.   Shootout: Choose a dude with value equal to or lower than Pancho's bounty. Send that dude home booted.

name: Grimoires & More
text: Controller React, Boot: After your Huckster enters play, pull. If the pull is a club, send that dude home booted; otherwise, attach a Hex from your discard pile to that dude, paying all costs.

name: J.W. Byrne, P. I.
text: Controller React, Boot: After drawing your lowball hand, but before revealing it, boot one of your Grifters at this location. Discard and redraw up to two cards from your lowball hand.

name: Knight's Chasuble
text: This dude's value cannot be reduced.  Conditions cannot be attached to this dude.  React, Boot: After this dude is booted by an opposing ability, unboot them.

name: Pedro
text: This dude has -3 value.  This dude cannot be moved by opposing card effects.

name: Aetheric Shockwave Inducer
text: Whenever this dude is declared as your shooter, pull. If the pull is a club, this card only provides +1 bullets this round (instead of +4).

name: The Gambler's Gun
text: After a Cheatin' Resolution is used against you, discard this dude.  Resolution, Boot: If this dude is your shooter, increase your hand rank by 2.

name: Calling the Cavalry
text: Shootout: During this round's resolution, both players gain +1 hand rank for each Horse in their posse. One dude in your posse becomes a stud until the end of the shootout.

name: Get Behind Me, Satan!
text: Resolution Miracle 5, Boot: Reduce your casualties this round by this dude's Blessed rating. Choose an opposing Abomination dude, who provides nothing to the posse's stud and draw ratings during the next round of the shootout.

name: Ghostly Communion
text: Noon Spirit 5, Boot: Move this dude to a Holy Ground location or to a location adjacent to one.  Shootout Spirit 7, Boot: This dude joins your posse at a Holy Ground location or a location adjacent to one. This dude becomes a stud.

name: All or Nothing
text: Noon Job: Mark a location. Dudes at that location can join the defending posse without permission from the mark. If successful, discard all cards attached to the location. If it's a deed or the town  square, discard all wanted and Abomination dudes at the location, and send the rest home booted.

name: Rite of Profane Abstersion
text: Shootout: Boot or discard a spell or Mystical goods from a dude in your posse. Send all A-value dudes and 0-bullet dudes home booted. Return all Sidekicks in this shootout to their owner's hand.

name: Showboating
text: If you pull this card for a skill test, you may immediately use its ability.   React: After one of your dudes successfully invents an Experimental Gadget, or succeeds with any other skill test by 5 or more, they permanently gain 1 control point.

name: House of Many Faiths
text: Noon, Boot: Choose your dude with a Miracle, and shuffle a card from your hand and a card from your discard pile into your deck. That dude moves to the town square, unboots, and gets +1 influence.

name: Office of Ancestral Affairs
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark an in-town deed with less than 2 control points. Your posse must have 3 or more bullets. If successful, the mark permanently gains +1 control points. If unopposed, you may attach a Totem from your discard pile to the mark even if you don't control it or have a Shaman there.

name: Bayou Vermilion Railroad
text: Reduce the cost of the first Mystical card you play each turn by 1.  Noon, Boot: Boot your Mystical card at a deed. Gain 1 ghost rock, and you may reduce the deed's control points and production to 0 until after the next Upkeep phase.

name: Fort 51
text: React: After you invent a Gadget Weapon or Gadget dude, give 1 bounty to an opposing dude with influence less than the Gadget's printed cost.  Noon, Boot: Boot your Gadget that is not at your home and remove 1 bounty from an opposing dude. Gain 1 ghost rock and you may discard a card.

name: Smith and Robards Trade Show
text: Noon, Boot: Boot your Gadget goods to discard a card and then draw a card. If that Gadget is at a location you control but do not own, that Gadget gains a control point (until the end of the turn).

name: Jonah's Alliance
text: Noon, Boot: Boot your dude at a non-home location. That dude becomes a stud, uses bullets instead of influence to control deeds, and gains 2 bounty, to a maximum of 4 bounty. You may boot your Hex (at any location) to remove all traits, abilities, and bonuses from an attachment at that dude's location.

name: Doc Holliday
text: If you are the leader and do not have a spellcaster in your posse, your posse has a -2 stud penalty.  Shootout, Boot: Give your dude a bullet bonus equal to the spellcaster skill rating of a dude in this shootout. That dude has a maximum bullet rating of 4.

name: Ke Wang
text: Shootout: Pay an opposing dude's controller that dude's upkeep. Boot that dude and give them -1 bullets.

name: Baijiu Sue
text: While Sue is at a Saloon deed, the deed has +1 control points.

name: Reverend Bob Hungate
text: Resolution, Boot: Choose a dude in your posse and pay the opposing player ghost rock equal to that dude's influence. Your opponent chooses a dude in their posse. Both dudes cannot be chosen as casualties this shootout round.

name: Father Diamond
text: Noon: If Diamond is at a deed you do not own, pay the owner 1 ghost rock. You may send one of your dudes at the deed home. Move Diamond to another location.

name: Master Shou
text: Noon: Boot your Abomination dude at this or an adjacent deed. The deed's owner must pay you 1 ghost rock, if able.

name: Brother Petrovic
text: React: When Petrovic would be discarded or aced during a shootout, the opposing player must pay you ghost rock equal to his influence, if able.

name: Leychaa'i Youngheart
text: Noon/Shootout: Move a non-Spirit Sidekick from your dude at this or an adjacent location to another of your dudes at this or an adjacent location.

name: Monomi Miles
text: Resolution, Boot: If your hand is legal and your hand rank is higher, boot Miles's Sidekick to increase the casualties of both posses by his Kung Fu rating.

name: Klah
text: Shootout, Boot: Boot Klah's Sidekick to give your dude with a Sidekick +1 bullets.

name: Black Elk (Exp.1)
text: If Black Elk is at a deed, he uses his Shaman skill rating to check control of the deed instead of his influence.

name: Nathaniel Tuwikaa
text: Noon: Nathaniel calls out a dude at his location. When forming shootout hands this shootout, all dudes use their influence instead of bullets to determine how many cards each player draws (but keep their bullet type).

name: The Faceless One
text: Shootout: Choose an opposing dude. The Faceless One gets a bullet bonus equal to that dude’s bullets, to a maximum bonus of 4. If that dude has grit 11 or higher, that dude has a maximum bullet rating of 4.

name: Lorena Corbett
text: Shootout: Choose an opposing dude. That dude is considered to have a minimum grit of 11 for your card effects. You may boot Lorena's Mystical goods to boot that dude.

name: Auntie Sinister
text: While Auntie Sinister has a Mystical goods and is in a posse, she gets a bonus to her Huckster skill equal to her influence.  React: After Auntie Sinister passes a Huckster skill check by 6 or more during a shootout, she gains +2 bullets.

name: Mason Adler
text: Mason cannot have non-Melee Weapons attached.  Noon Job, Boot: Mark the opposing dude with the highest grit of 11 or higher (you choose in case of a tie). No other dudes can join your posse. If successful, ace the mark.  Repeat Shootout: If an opposing dude with the highest grit is in the opposing posse, Mason gains the Abomination keyword and becomes a stud. You can use this ability once per shootout.

name: Enrique Dos Santos
text: React: After a wanted dude who is not at home accepts a callout from Enrique, other dudes cannot join the mark's posse until after posses are formed.

name: Reverend Endicott
text: React: After you attach a miracle to Endicott, choose an opposing dude with lower influence than the number of miracles attached to Endicott to raise that dude's bounty by 1.

name: Sgt. Elijah Clay
text: After each Shootout play (including passing) while Elijah is in your posse, if the opposing posse has greater total bounty than total bullets, Elijah becomes a stud and has a minimum bullet rating of 3.

name: Wyatt Earp
text: If your outfit is Law Dogs, reduce Wyatt's cost by 2 for each of your Law Dogs dudes in Boot Hill.  While Wyatt is in your posse, your shooter gets +2 bullets if the opposing shooter's bounty is greater than their bullets.  Cheatin' Resolution: Ace the opposing shooter or a wanted dude in the opposing posse.

name: Roberto Muratore
text: Noon: Boot Roberto's Experimental Gadget at your in-town deed with 1 control point and pull twice. If one pull was red, give this deed a control point. If both pulls are red, that control point is permanent.

name: Adelaide Rose
text: Shootout: Boot Adelaide's Gadget to give an opposing dude -1 bullets. If that Gadget is Experimental, give your dude +1 bullets.

name: Dr. Gregory Tremane
text: If your outfit is Entrepreneurs, reduce Gregory's cost by the number of Gadgets you control.  Shootout: Boot a Gadget in your posse to send an opposing dude without a Gadget home booted.

name: Big Nose Kate
text: Noon: Discard a card to give your dude at this location +1 bullets. If you discarded an action card with a Shootout or Job ability, that dude gets +1 influence. If that dude is not wanted, you may give that dude 1 bounty.

name: Johnny Ringo
text: If Johnny is wanted and the only dude in your posse, only shooters contribute to draw hand bonuses.  Shootout: Until the next round of this shootout, dudes cannot be chosen or affected by their opponent's React, Shootout, or non-Cheatin' Resolution abilities.

name: Violet Esperanza
text: Shootout: Choose an opposing dude with bullets less than Violet's bounty while Violet is attempting a job. Ace Violet's Hex and pull. If the pull is greater than that dude's value, ace that dude.

name: Curly Bill Brocius
text: After you reveal a higher hand rank than the opposing posse during a shootout, give one of your dudes 1 bounty.  React, Boot: After you win a shootout round with Curly Bill in your posse, if your posse has more total bounty than the opposing posse, the opposing posse takes 2 extra casualties.

name: Byron Decker
text: While Byron has a Gadget Weapon, he gets +1 influence.  React: Before Byron is aced as a casualty, by a Shootout ability, or by a non-Cheatin’ Resolution ability, discard another of your dudes in your posse to prevent Byron from being aced.

name: Carter Richardson
text: If there is a wanted dude in the opposing posse, you may play Carter from your hand (into your posse) as a Shootout play, paying his cost.  Noon: Move Carter to the location of a wanted dude with the highest bounty (you choose in case of a tie).

name: Valeria Batten (Exp.1)
text: Valeria can invent Mystical Gadgets using her Huckster skill.  While Valeria is in a shootout, hand ranks cannot be modified by Shootout, React, or non-Cheatin' Resolution abilities.  Noon: Boot your dude and give them +1 influence.

name: Steph and Gertie's Tonsorium
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Shuffle a card from your hand into your deck. Discard the top card of your deck.

name: Gateway Station
text: Controller React, Pay 1 Ghost Rock, Boot: Before discarding your lowball draw hand, discard a card from your play hand. Take a dude card from your lowball draw hand and put them into your play hand.

name: Hart's Tea Shoppe
text: Controller Shootout, Boot: Boot an opposing card.

name: Bird Cage Theater
text: Controller Noon Job, Boot: Mark an opposing dude with 1 or more control points. If successful, remove all control points from the mark and this deed gains a permanent +1 control point and +1 production.

name: Cochise County Courthouse
text: Controller Noon Job, Boot: Mark the town square. Your posse must have 4 or more bullets. If successful, you may pay ghost rock equal to an opposing dude's influence to boot all cards attached to that dude and move that dude to town square booted.

name: Gage Export Co.
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Shuffle a card in your discard pile into your deck. Discard the top card of your deck.

name: Magnum Opus Tenebri
text: A Huckster can invent this Gadget using their Huckster skill.  Shootout, Boot: Boot this dude to send an opposing dude with value less than your posse's total bullets home booted. If that dude’s value is less than your posse’s total bullets by 4 or more, you may ace your Abomination dude to ace that dude.

name: Scattergun
text: Shootout, Boot: If this dude has 1 or more bullets, discard a token dude or a Sidekick with cost equal to or less than this dude’s bullets.  Shootout, Boot: An opposing dude with 0 influence does not contribute to draw hand bonuses unless they are the shooter.

name: Adler's Needle
text: Shootout, Boot: Choose an opposing dude at this or an adjacent location not in the shootout. That dude’s controller may have that dude join their posse. If that dude does not join, this dude gains a permanent control point. If this dude has higher grit than that dude and they do not join, that dude gets -1 influence while not at home until after Sundown.

name: Wrathful Spider
text: Cheatin' Resolution Spirit 5, Boot: Send the opposing shooter home booted.  Shootout Spirit 6, Boot: Give an opposing dude -1 bullets. If successful by 6 or more, boot that dude.

name: Guiding Light
text: Noon Miracle 5, Boot: Pay another player 1 ghost rock to send your dude at this or an adjacent location home. If you have less ghost rock than that player, unboot that dude.  Noon Miracle 5, Boot: Pay another player 2 ghost rock to send that player’s dude at this or an adjacent location home.

name: Champion
text: Cheatin' Resolution Miracle 6, Boot: Gain 1 ghost rock.  Shootout Miracle 8, Boot: Boot your dude to make them a stud. If that dude is discarded or aced, gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Malison
text: Shootout Hex 9, Boot: Choose an opposing dude. Your posse gets a +1 draw hand bonus of that dude’s bullet type while that dude is in the shootout. If that dude is aced or discarded during this shootout, give this dude a permanent +1 influence.

name: Dancing Butterfly
text: Resolution Spirit 10, Boot: If your hand is legal, the opposing player can have a second Cheatin' Resolution played against them. The opposing player may cancel this effect by sending one of their dudes home booted and giving one of your deeds a permanent control point (opponent chooses deed).

name: Ten-Foot Punch
text: Shootout Technique: This dude gets +1 Kung Fu and joins your posse. If this dude has a Kung Fu rating greater than or equal to the bullet rating of an opposing dude, reveal the top 5 cards of your deck and you may add a non-Tao Technique to your hand from those cards. Discard all other revealed cards.

name: Fleet-Footed
text: Noon: Send your dude home booted.  Shootout: Give your dude +1 bullets and an opposing dude -1 bullets.

name: You're A Daisy If You Do
text: Noon: Boot your stud in town square to move an opposing dude to town square. If that dude has more control points than your stud, boot the opposing dude; otherwise, unboot the opposing dude. Your stud calls out that dude.

name: Twilight Is Upon Us
text: Shootout: All shooters have +2 bullets while in a posse with a skilled dude. Your skilled dude joins your posse (moving if necessary).

name: Test of Wills
text: Shootout: Boot an opposing card. If it is a goods or spell, it loses all abilities, traits, and bonuses.  React: After posses are formed, if your posse has more total bullets than the opposing posse, shootout plays cannot cause dudes to join posses or cause dudes to leave the shootout.

name: Avie Cline
text: Noon, Boot: If Avie is at a deed in town, choose an opposing dude with lower influence in town. Move them to Avie’s location.

name: Judge Harry Somerset
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark a wanted dude. A 2-stud Gunslinger token enters play booted and joins your posse. If successful, discard the mark. Remove the Gunslinger from the game after the job.

name: Ebenezer Springfield
text: React: After another player’s ability affects your dude at this or an adjacent location, add one bounty to one of that player’s dudes who is not wanted.

name: Elander Boldman
text: Shootout, Boot: Unboot a Gadget. You can use its abilities another time. If it's Experimental, unboot Elander. If it's a Weapon, it provides an extra +1 bullets and its dude becomes a stud.

name: Antheia Pansofia
text: If you pull a club while making a Huckster skill test for someone in Antheia's posse, add 3 to the skill check.

name: Harry Highbinder
text: Cannot attach weapons.  While Harry is at the town square and you have more influence there than any other player, you control the town square (it has no keywords).

name: Max Baine
text: If Max is at the town square or a Government deed, Ranches provide no control points.  Noon, Boot: Play a dude with a value of 10 or higher at Max’s location, reducing their cost by 3 ghost rock (minimum 0).

name: El Grajo
text: Shootout: Boot a Melee Weapon attached to El Grajo to make him a stud and give him +2 bullets, to a maximum rating of 4 bullets.

name: Jacqueline Isham
text: Repeat React: When Jacqueline joins a mark’s posse, or a posse opposing a job, she becomes a stud.

name: Huntsmen's Society
text: The controller's dudes at this and adjacent locations with a value of 10 or higher get -1 upkeep.

name: Secured Stockyard
text: This deed must be invented by an in-town Mad Scientist. It enters play like a deed.  Controller Noon, Boot: Gain one ghost rock.

name: La Quema
text: This dude gets +3 value.  While this dude has a Melee Weapon, they get +1 bullets.  Shootout, Boot: This dude joins your posse (moving if necessary). Boot an opposing dude.

name: Asyncoil Gun
text: Shootout, Boot: Pull. If it's a club, discard this dude. If not, discard an opposing dude with value less than or equal to this dude's bullets.

name: Scoop Hound
text: Shootout, Boot: Shootout plays cannot bring dudes into either posse or send dudes home booted (they remain in the posse without booting).

name: Rapier
text: 'If there is an unbooted non-Melee Weapon in the opposing posse, Rapier provides +0 bullets.  This dude gets +1 value.

name: Vitality Tonic
text: This dude gains the keyword Abomination.  React: When this dude is aced in a shootout, discard them instead.  Repeat Noon, Pay 2 Ghost Rock: Pull. If the pull is a club, discard this dude. If not, unboot them.

name: Consecration
text: Cheatin’ Resolution Miracle 7: One of your dudes gets +2 bullets and +2 influence and becomes a stud until after Sundown. If this is a shootout, reduce your casualties this round by 3.

name: Mark of Pestilence
text: Shootout Hex 9, Boot: Boot all other unbooted dudes.

name: Cookin' Up Trouble
text: Noon: Look at another player's hand. If that player has revealed an illegal draw hand this turn, you may choose one action, goods or spell card in their hand that does not have a Cheatin' ability. Discard that card.

name: Ol' Fashioned Hangin'
text: Noon Job: Mark a wanted dude with at least 2 bounty. If successful, ace the mark; also, your leader (if still in play) permanently gets 1 control point.

name: No Turning Back
text: Noon: Ace a dude you own and control to gain ghost rock equal to their cost.  Resolution: Ace a dude you own and control to reduce your casualties this round to zero. Choose a dude who gets +2 bullets and becomes a stud. Your dudes cannot flee this round.

name: 1st Baptist Church
text: Raise the controller’s hand size by one.

name: A Coach Comes to Town
text: Noon Job: Mark the town square. If successful, gain 4 ghost rock. If not, each player with a dude in the opposing posse gains 4 ghost rock.

name: A Secret Tunnel
text: Noon: Move your dude from one in-town deed you own to another in-town deed you own (without booting). Make another Noon play.

name: Abram Grothe
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark a Holy Ground deed. If successful, discard all Abominations and wanted dudes at that deed.

name: Ace in the Hole
text: React Hex 6, Boot: When you reveal your draw hand in a shootout, boot this Huckster. Ace a card in your draw hand. Replace it with a card from your play hand.

name: Allie Hensman
text: Noon, Boot: If Allie is at the town square, she permanently gets 1 control point.

name: Ambush
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark a dude. If the mark is not wanted, raise the bounty on each dude in your posse by 1. If successful, ace the mark.

name: Androcles Brocklehurst
text: Noon, Boot: Choose another player’s dude at a deed you own but don’t control. Gain ghost rock equal to that dude’s influence.

name: Arnold McCadish
text: React, Pull, Boot: When a dude is discarded (not aced) as a casualty in a shootout, if the pull is higher than the dude’s value, send that dude home booted instead.

name: Auction
text: Noon: Choose a deed in play. It becomes Private. If you own and control that deed, gain 1 ghost rock for each dude controlled by another player at that deed.

name: Auto Cattle-Feeder
text: After this is invented, attach it to a Ranch that you control.  Controller Noon, Boot: Gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Auto-Revolver
text: You may equip this Gadget as a Shootout play (pay all costs).  When forming a shootout hand, when you redraw after discarding at least one card, you may draw one extra card.

name: B&B Attorneys
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Raise or lower the bounty on a wanted dude by one (if the bounty goes to zero, the dude is no longer wanted).

name: Bad Company
text: Noon: Choose a wanted dude. That dude gets +3 bullets and is a stud. If the dude is discarded or aced, the player responsible gains 4 extra ghost rock.

name: Bank of California
text: Players cannot take ghost rock from the Bank’s controller.

name: Barton Everest
text: If you reveal a cheatin’ hand in Barton’s shootout, raise your draw hand rank by 1 for this round..

name: Blake Ranch
text: Private • Ranch  Out of Town

name: Blood Curse
text: Noon Hex 9, Boot: A dude at this or an adjacent location gets –1 influence and –1 bullets.  Shootout Hex 9, Boot: One opposing dude gets –2 bullets.

name: Bluetick
text: Sidekick (This card can be discarded to cover one casualty.)  Noon, Boot: Move this dude to the same location as a wanted dude.

name: Bobo
text: Bobo gains a bullet bonus equal to the highest Huckster skill rating in play.

name: Bottom Dealin'
text: Cheatin’ Resolution:Discard the cheatin’ player’s draw hand and replace it with the top five cards of your deck (those cards still go to your discard pile).

name: Bounty Hunter
text: Noon: A 2-stud Gunslinger token enters play at a wanted dude’s location. The Gunslinger calls out that dude, who cannot refuse. Remove the Gunslinger token from the game after the shootout.

name: Buffalo Rifle
text: If this dude is adjacent to the location of a shootout or a job’s mark, they can join a posse, without moving or booting, even if booted.

name: Bunkhouse
text: Dudes with 0 or 1 influence, excluding any modifiers from this deed, have +1 influence while at this deed.

name: Carter's Bounties
text: Controller Shootout, Boot: Move your dude into your posse from any location.

name: Cattle Market
text: This deed has 1 control point if another Ranch is in play.  All dudes have their value raised by 3 while at this deed.

name: Charlie's Place
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Raise or lower the bullets of a dude at this location by 2.

name: Cheatin' Varmint
text: Resolution: Pay 5 ghost rock to lower a player’s draw hand by 2 ranks.  Cheatin’ Resolution: Lower a player’s draw hand by 2 ranks.

name: Circle M Ranch
text: Controller Noon, Boot: If you have 3 or fewer cards in your play hand, draw a card.

name: Clear Out!
text: Noon: Move your dude to a deed that you own but do not control.

name: Clementine Lepp
text: While in a Saloon you own, Clementine gets +1 influence and cannot be called out.

name: Clyde Owens
text: Noon: Clyde calls out a dude at his location. A wanted dude cannot refuse the call out.

name: Coachwhip!
text: Cheatin’ Resolution: The cheatin’ player must boot one of their dudes. If in a shootout, that dude gets aced instead. If you have a legal hand, you choose the dude to boot or ace.

name: Concealed Weapons
text: Noon: You may use shoppin’ as a Shootout play, and at any location.

name: Dead Dog Tavern
text: Determine control of this deed using bullets instead of influence.

name: Doyle's Hoyle
text: React, Boot: After this dude makes a pull, discard the pull to replace it with this card.  Resolution Boot: Discard a card from your draw hand to replace it with this card. If the discarded card was a 2, raise your hand rank by one.

name: Dr. Dawn Edwards
text: If you discard Dawn as a casualty, you may search your deck for Eve Henry (if you don’t already have her in play), and play her for free at this location. Shuffle your deck.

name: Elander Boldman
text: Shootout, Pull: Choose your dude with a Weapon Gadget in this shootout. If the pull is a club, discard that dude. Otherwise, that Gadget gets +3 bullets.

name: Establishin' Who's in Charge
text: Noon Job: Mark an in-town deed. If successful, the deed permanently gains 1 control point.

name: Eve Henry
text: If you discard Eve as a casualty, you may search your deck for Dr. Dawn Edwards (if you don’t already have her in play), and play her for free at this location. Shuffle your deck.

name: Extortion
text: Noon: Choose a deed that you control but do not own. Gain ghost rock equal to its production.

name: Flame-Thrower
text: This dude is a stud.  Shootout, Pay 1–3 Ghost Rock, Boot: Raise the bullets on this Gadget by 1 for each ghost rock spent. Each round’s loser takes 1 extra casualty.

name: Force Field
text: Repeat Resolution, Pay X Ghost Rock: Raise your draw hand rank by X for this round, but not to exceed your opponent’s hand rank.

name: Fred Aims
text: Fred’s influence is equal to his bounty.

name: Fresh Horses
text: Noon: Unboot all your Horses at one location. Any abilities on the Horses that have been used can be used an extra time.

name: General Store
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Attach a goods or spell (as shoppin’), reducing the cost of that card by 2 ghost rock.

name: Gomorra Parish
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Ace a card from your hand to gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Good Stiff Drink
text: Noon: Choose a dude’s ability that has been used. That ability can be used another time.

name: Harold Aimslee
text: Noon, Boot: Discard a card from your hand to get a non-Weapon Gadget from your discard pile. Show the card and add it to your hand.

name: Hex Slingin'
text: Resolution: Discard a Hex from your dude in this posse to raise your draw hand rank by 2.

name: Hiding in the Shadows
text: Noon: Choose one of your dudes. Other players cannot choose or affect that dude with Shootout abilities.

name: Hired Guns
text: Noon: Place a dude from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Hot Lead Flyin'
text: React: After you take casualties forlosing a round of a shootout, pull. For each dude you have (still in the posse) with a value higher than the pull, the winner takes 1 casualty.

name: Irving Patterson
text: When Irving joins a posse, gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Ivor Hawley
text: While he has a Hex, Ivor gets +1 bullets, +1 influence, and +1 Huckster skill.

name: James Ghetty
text: When James enters a posse, place 4 ghost rock on him. The ghost rock may be used to pay for Shootout abilities (it is not a bounty). Discard his unused ghost rock after the shootout.

name: Jarrett Blake
text: Shootout: If Jarrett has a Horse, swap him with one of your dudes in the posse (Jarrett joins the posse. The other dude moves to Jarrett’s location and is no longer in the posse).

name: Jia Mein
text: Shootout: Attach a Hex to Jia Mein (paying all costs) to make him a stud.

name: Joker (red)
text: This card is only used for draw hands and pulls.  You choose its suit and value. Ace the joker after use.

name: Joker (black)
text: This card is only used for draw hands and pulls.  You choose its suit and value. Ace the joker after use.

name: Jon Longstride
text: Noon: Unboot Jon’s Horse. You may use the Horse’s ability an additional time.

name: Jonah Essex
text: Other wanted dudes in Jonah’s posse get +1 bullets.

name: Judge Harry Somerset
text: Noon Job, Boot: Harry leads a job that marks a wanted dude. If successful, ace the mark.

name: Kevin Wainwright
text: Noon: Move Kevin (without booting) to the same location as a Huckster. Kevin becomes a stud.

name: Kidnappin'
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark a dude. Your posse must have more total bullets than the marked dude. Raise the bounty of each dude in your posse by 1. If successful, discard the mark.

name: Killer Bunnies Casino
text: The controller of this deed may discard one additional card each Sundown phase.

name: Lady Luck
text: Noon: You can discard as many of your cards as you like during Sundown.

name: Lane Healey
text: Lane gets +2 bullets while he has a Horse.

name: Law Dogs
text: Noon, Boot: Choose a dude. Boot your dudes with a total influence greater than the chosen dude’s influence to raise that dude’s bounty by 1.

name: Lawrence Blackwood
text: Noon, Boot: If Lawrence is at a deed you do not own, he is worth 1 control point while he stays at that deed.

name: Legendary Holster
text: Shootout Pull, Boot: If the pull is lower than this dude’s bullets, ace one dude in the opposing posse.

name: Lucinda "Lucy" Clover
text: If your opponent in Lucy’s shootout reveals a cheatin’ hand, raise the bounty on each dude in their posse by 1 (including from 0 to 1).

name: Magical Distraction
text: Cheatin’ Resolution: Discard a spell from your dude in this posse and pull. Your draw hand rank equals the value of your pull (to a 0 maximum rank of 11).

name: Make the Smart Choice
text: Shootout: Reduce a dude’s bullets by their influence. The dude’s controller may move them home booted (even if already booted).

name: Marion Seville
text: Marion gets +2 bullets while he is wanted.

name: Max Baine
text: Max is worth 1 control point while you control 2 or more Ranches.  Your other dudes at Ranches get +1 influence and +3 value.

name: Mechanical Horse
text: Repeat Noon, Pay 2 Ghost Rock: Move this dude.  React, Boot: Prevent this dude from booting when they join a posse (this does not let a booted dude join a posse).

name: Micah Ryse
text: Noon: Boot a Hex on Micah to move him (without booting).

name: Missed!
text: Shootout: Unboot one of your dudes in this posse.

name: Mongwau the Mighty
text: Shootout: Discard a Hex from Mongwau to make him a stud.

name: Morgan Cattle Co.
text: Noon, Boot: Boot one of your dudes to play a deed, reducing the deed’s cost by the dude’s influence. Move that dude to that deed.

name: Mustang
text: Noon, Boot: Move this dude (without booting).

name: One Good Turn…
text: Noon: Draw a card.  Cheatin' Resolution: Gain 3 ghost rock.

name: Pair of Six-Shooters
text: Cheatin’ Resolution, Boot: One card in your draw hand changes to the suit and value of your choice.

name: Peacemaker
text: This dude cannot be changed to a draw, and cannot have their bullets lowered by another player’s Shootout ability.

name: Pearl-handled Revolver
text: This dude is a stud.

name: Pearly's Palace
text: Controller React, Boot: After a shootout starts but before any player makes a Shootout play, make a Shootout play.

name: Philip Swinford
text: Each time a player reveals a cheatin’ hand and your hand is legal, you may discard a card from your play hand to draw a card.

name: Pinned Down
text: Shootout: Choose a dude. They must be selected as the first casualty. If that dude is chosen as the shooter, they get –3 bullets (minimum 0).

name: Pinto
text: Shootout, Boot: Move this dude into a posse (without booting; this can move a booted dude).

name: Pistol Whip
text: Shootout: Boot your dude in this posse to send a dude in the other posse home booted. Your dude gets –1 bullets (minimum 0).

name: Point Blank
text: Resolution: Boot your stud dude in this posse. Your opponent must ace a dude in their posse with lower bullets than your dude’s bullets.

name: Pony Express
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Discard a card to draw a card.

name: Prescott Utter
text: Prescott’s bullets and influence are equal to the number of Law Dogs at his location (including himself).

name: Prof. Eustace True
text: Noon: Discard a Gadget from Eustace to move him to another location (without booting).

name: Quickdraw Handgun
text: Cheatin’ Resolution, Boot: If you have a legal draw hand, exchange draw hands with the cheatin’ player.  Cheatin’ cards cannot be played on you for this round of the shootout.

name: Railroad Station
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Move your dude from this location to another location (without booting).

name: Raising Hell
text: Shootout Hex 8, Boot: Ace a card from your play hand. One Abomination from your Boot Hill enters play (pay all costs) and joins this Huckster’s posse. Ace this card.

name: Ramiro Mendoza
text: Whenever Ramiro joins a posse, pay 1 ghost rock.  If you do not or cannot pay, discard him.

name: Recruitment Drive
text: Noon Job: Mark the town square (any player may oppose the job). If successful, put a dude or deed into play from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 5 ghost rock.

name: Rémy Lapointe
text: Shootout, Pay 1–4 Ghost Rock: Rémy gets +1 bullets for each ghost rock spent, to a maximum rating of 5 bullets.

name: Reserves
text: Noon: Gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Roan
text: React, Boot: Prevent this dude from booting when they join a posse (this does not allow a booted dude to join a posse).

name: Rumors
text: Noon: Choose a dude. That dude gets –1 influence while at any location except home.

name: Run 'em Down!
text: Noon: Choose any number of your dudes, each with a Horse, at one location. Move them to an adjacent location that has an opposing dude without a Horse. Boot that dude. You may call that dude out.

name: Sanford Taylor
text: Noon, Boot: Call out a dude at this deed. If Sanford is wanted, the call-out cannot be refused.

name: Shadow Walk
text: Noon Hex 7, Boot: Move this Huckster to any location.  Shootout Hex 7, Boot: Move this Huckster to join your posse. You may make another Shootout play.

name: Sheriff Dave Montreal
text: If your opponent in Dave’s shootout reveals a cheatin’ hand and you do not, your dudes cannot be casualties this round.

name: Shotgun
text: Shootout, Boot: Choose and ace an opposing dude in this shootout with a value less than or equal to this dude’s bullets.

name: Silas Aims
text: Silas’s bullets are equal to his bounty.

name: Sloane
text: Sloane’s bounty cannot be reduced below 1.  Sloane and your other dudes at her location do not boot when forming or joining a posse.

name: Soul Blast
text: Shootout Hex X, Boot: Choose a dude in this shootout. X is that dude’s grit. If successful, send the dude home booted. If successful by 6 or more, ace the dude instead. If unsuccessful, move this Huckster home booted.

name: Stagecoach Office
text: Controller React, Boot: When you bring a non-token dude into play, place that dude at any location you control.

name: Sun in Yer Eyes
text: Shootout: Choose a dude in this shootout. That dude gets –2 bullets (minimum 0) and becomes a draw.

name: Takin' Ya With Me
text: React: After you take casualties for losing a round of a shootout, your opponent takes 1 casualty unless each dude in their posse has higher bullets than the highest bullets among your casualties.

name: Telegraph Office
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Choose a dude that was brought into play this Noon phase. Gain ghost rock equal to the dude’s influence.

name: The Fourth Ring
text: React, Boot: After your dude succeeds at a spell pull while not at home, you may discard a card from your hand to gain 1 ghost rock and draw a card.

name: The Ghostly Gun
text: Resolution: Put The Ghostly Gun into your draw hand; he becomes the suit and value of your choice. Discard a card from your draw hand.

name: Morgan Research Institute
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Raise or lower the skill rating of a dude at this location by 2 (the skills are Huckster, Blessed, Shaman, and Mad Scientist).

name: The Pharmacy
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Unboot a dude.

name: The Sloane Gang
text: Noon, Boot: Boot your dude in the town square. If that dude is still in the town square during the Sundown phase, either gain 1 ghost rock per other player, or your dude permanently gets 1 control point if they do not already have one.

name: The Stakes Just Rose
text: Shootout: Move one of your dudes into your posse. That dude becomes a stud.

name: The Town Hall
text: Government • Controller React, Boot: At the start of the Upkeep phase, choose a dude at this location. Lower that dude’s upkeep by their influence.

name: The Union Casino
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Choose your dude at this location and pay any amount of ghost rock. Each other player may then pay any amount of ghost rock. If you paid at least 4 ghost rock more than any other player, your dude permanently gets 1 control point.

name: This is a Holdup!
text: Noon: Boot your dude at a deed you don’t own to take ghost rock from the owner up to the production of that  deed. Raise the bounty on your dude by the amount of ghost rock taken.

name: Tin Star
text: Wanted dudes cannot refuse a call-out from this dude.

name: Tommy Harden
text: If your opponent in Tommy’s shootout reveals a cheatin’ hand, raise your draw hand rank by 1 for this round.  If your draw hand is also legal, raise your hand rank by 2 instead.

name: Travis Moone
text: Grifter (You may only have one Grifter in your starting posse.)  React, Boot: At the start of the game, shuffle your play hand into your deck and draw 5 cards.

name: Tresspassin'
text: Noon: Choose a Private deed you own. Other players’ dudes there must move home booted, or gain 1 bounty each.

name: Tyxarglenak
text: Abomination  Other players cannot choose or affect your Hucksters at this location with action cards if they could legally choose to affect Tyxarglenak instead.

name: Undertaker
text: This deed’s controller gains 2 ghost rock each time a dude is aced.

name: Unprepared
text: Shootout: Boot a dude and their attached cards. That dude gets –1 bullets and cannot use abilities. Their attached cards lose all traits, abilities, and bullet bonuses.

name: War Paint
text: Noon: One of your dudes gets +2 bullets.

name: Whiskey Flask
text: Noon, Boot: Boot this dude and discard a card from your hand to draw a card.

name: Xiong "Wendy" Cheng
text: Shootout, Boot: Send an opposing dude home booted.

name: Yan Li's Tailoring
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Raise a dude’s influence by 1.

name: Rabbit's Deception
text: Shootout Tao Technique: If successful, send this dude home booted. If your dude was unbooted when you played this card, you may also send an opposing dude home booted. Combo if there is a stud in the opposing posse.

name: A Hero's Passing
text: Play only if a dude has been aced this turn.  While this card is attached to your home, increase your maximum hand size by 1. Discard this card when a dude you own is aced.  Noon Job: Mark your home. If successful attach this card to your home and draw 2 cards.

name: Tummy Twister
text: While attached to a deed, this card attaches to the first dude to move here (the winner choose in case of a tie).    A dude with this card attached has +1 upkeep.    Noon: Attach this card to a deed.

name: Backroom Deals
text: React: Play when an opposing dude is discarded during the Upkeep phase. That dude remains in play instead. You control them until the end of the turn.  React: Play at the start of the Upkeep phase to give one of your dudes -2 upkeep until the end of the phase.

name: Civil War
text: Noon: Choose two dudes controlled by the same player in one location. Their controller moves one of those dudes to another location (without booting, and even if booted).

name: Forced Quarantine
text: Discard this dude at the of the turn.  Noon Job: Mark an opposing dude whose current influence, bullets or value are lower than their printed values. If successful, boot the mark, attach this card to them, and your leader gets one permanent control point.

name: The Extra Bet
text: React, Boot: After all players ante for lowball, add 1 additional ghost rock from your stash to the pot. After you draw your lowball hand, you may discard a card from your draw hand and replace it with the top card of your deck.

name: Morgan Mining Company
text: This deed has +1 production for each Strike you control.

name: Quarantine Tent
text: Dudes at this deed ignore all penalties to bullets, value, and influence (the penalties resume when the dudes leave this location).  Controller Noon, Boot: Boot one of your dudes at this location to unboot your outfit. You may use its abilities an extra time this turn.

name: Cooke's Nightcap
text: This deeds has 2 control points while controlled by a player other than its owner.

name: Margaret Hagerty
text: Margaret gets +3 to her Mad Scientist skill while inventing Gadget dudes.  Each Gadget dude at Margarets location has -1 upkeep.

name: The Wretched
text: The Wretched must be invented by a Mad Scientist. It enters play at the Mad Scientist's location (but does not attach).  After The Wretched enters play, ace a dude you own and control in the same location. The inventing Mad Scientist gains 2 bounty (if still in play).

name: Deborah West
text: Deborah is a stud while she is the leader (during a job or callin' out).

name: Abram Grothe
text: If your outfit is [Law Dogs], Abram's cost is reduced by the total bounty on other player's dudes (to a minimum of 0).  Noon/Shootout, Boot: Unboot all your Deputies at this and adjacent locations.

name: Dead Billy Jones
text: Noon: If you control a Ranch, choose a dude with an attached Horse in this or an adjacent location. Move that dude to another location

name: Lillian Morgan
text: If your outfit is [Morgan Cattle Co.], Lillian's cost is reduced by 1 for each Horse and Ranch you control.  Noon/Shootout: Play an action from your discard pile (as if it were in your hand). After the card resolves, boot a spell on Lillian or ace that action.

name: Jim Cheveyo
text: While at the same location as a Spirit, Jim has +1 influence and is a stud.

name: Enapay
text: Enapay has +2 influence during High Noon.  Noon, Boot: Another dude at this location gets +1 influence.

name: Danny Wilde
text: Danny cannot be called out by dudes with lower influence (not even through card effects).

name: Michael "The Badger" Dodge
text: While The Badger has a Melee Weapon he is a stud  Shootout, Boot: Boot an opposing dude. The Badger gets -3 bullets if the opposing posse has more unbooted dudes than your posse. Pull. If the pull is not a club, the dude you booted gets -3 bullets.

name: Asakichi Cooke
text: Noon: Discard a card. Move one of your other dudes from this location (without booting, even if booted).

name: Emre, The Turkish Bear
text: React: After any dude at this location makes a pull for a Technique, pull and use that value instead. Emre becomes a stud until the end of the turn

name: Dabney Scuttlesby
text: Dabney can only invent Mystical Gadgets.  Dabney can invent Mystical Gadgets and trade them to other dudes while in the town square.

name: Ivor Hawley
text: If your outfit is [The Fourth Ring], Ivor's cost is reduced by 1 for each Abomination in play and in any Boot Hill.  React: After Ivor enters play, play up to two hexes or abominations from your Boot Hill. Reduce those cards's cost by 3 each.

name: Samantha "Sammy" Cooke
