text: Noon Technique: If successful, your dude has +1 influence and +2 Kung Fu while not at home, and you may discard up to five cards from the top of your deck.

name: Rabbit's Lunar Leap
text: Shootout Tao Technique: If successful, move this dude into your posse. You may unboot this dude. Combo if your posse does not have more dudes than the opposing posse.

name: Zhu's Reward
text: Shootout Tao Technique, Boot: If successful, all opposing dudes with value lower than this dude's bullets are sent home booted.

name: Zhu's Ferocity
text: Shootout Tao Technique: If successful, this dude gets +1 bullets and an opposing dude gets -1 bullets. Combo if this dude has higer bullets than the opposing dude.

name: Mazatl
text: Noon: Move Mazatl to a location where there is a Totem.

name: Marcia Ridge
text: While Marcia is in the Town Square and you have more influence there than each other player, you may use Controller abilities on adjacent deeds as if you controlled them.

name: Lydia Bear-Hands
text: Resolution, Boot: Boot a Spirit on Lydia. One of your dudes gets the Harrowed keyword until the end of the shootout.

name: Jackson Trouble
text: React: After Jackson moves to or from an Out of Town location, unboot him.

name: Three-Eyed Hawk
text: After you attach a Sidekick to Hawk from your hand, gain 1 ghost rock.  Sidekicks attached to Hawk can be aced to cover two casualties.

name: Butch Deuces
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Spirit or Attire from those cards to shuffle your play hand into your deck and take those cards into your play hand. Otherwise, return the cards to your deck in the same order.

name: Smiling Frog
text: Noon: Discard a card to give Smiling Frog +1 bullets. If the card was a Spirit, he gets +2 bullets instead.

name: Sarah Meoquanee
text: Shootout: If a dude in your posse has 3 or more influence, or if a Spirit is at the shootout location, Sarah joins the posse (moving if necessary) and becomes a stud.

name: Chief Stephen Seven-Eagles
text: If your outfit is Eagle Wardens, Chief Stephen's cost is reduced by 1 for each card (any player's) attached to any location(s).  Noon, Boot: While at the town square, Chief Stephen is worth 1 control point for each card attached to deeds you control.

name: Laughing Crow
text: Noon: Reveal the top two cards of your deck. You may attach any revealed Spirits , paying all costs. Discard the rest.

name: Benjamin Washington
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, discard one or more cards from your hand. For each card you discard, one dude gets -2 upkeep (to a minimum of 0) until High Noon. Draw a card.

name: Randall
text: While Randall is at a location with two or more other dudes (any players'), your maximum hand size is increased by one.

name: Longwei Fu
text: While Longwei is at home, your posse has an extra +1 stud bonus (at any location, even if Longwei is not in the posse).

name: Xui Yin Chen
text: Shootout, Boot: All dudes in your posse become studs and get +1 influence.

name: Natalya
text: At the start of the Upkeep phase, if you have less ghost rock in your stash than each other player, you gain the production of the deed at Natalya's location this turn, and other players do not.

name: Hamshanks
text: While Hamshanks is unbooted at a location you control, other players cannot choose or affect your dudes at this location with their abilities if they could legally choose to affect Hamshanks instead.

name: Hiram Capatch
text: Each of your other dudes at this and adjacent locations has +1 influence during the Upkeep phase.

name: Yunxu Jiang
text: While Yunxu is in a shootout at a location you control, each of your other dudes in the posse has +1 bullets and +1 value.

name: Abuelita Espinoza
text: While Abuelita is at a deed you do not own, each of your other dudes has -1 upkeep.

name: Bai Yang Chen
text: While Bai Yang is at another player's home, your maximum hand size is increased by two and Bai Yang has -1 upkeep.

name: Daomei Wang
text: React: After Daomei Wang comes into play during High Noon, move one of your other 108 dudes to another location (without booting).

name: Xiaodan Li
text: Xiaodan does not count toward the number of dudes in your starting posse.

name: T'ou Chi Chow
text: If your outfit is 108 Righteous Bandits, T'ou Chi Chow's cost is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0) for each deed you control.  Noon/Shootout, Repeat: Boot a deed you control to unboot a dude at that deed or adjacent to it.

name: Nunchucks
text: Can only attach to a dude with Kung Fu. While in a posse, this dude has +1 Kung Fu.  React, Boot: If this dude is in a posse, after a player pulls, reduce the pull by this dude's Kung Fu rating.

name: Idol of Tlazolteotl
text: During High Noon, this dude has +2 influence.  Noon, Boot: Choose a card that you own and that is attached to a location. Attach it legally to a deed you control.

name: Eagle Wardens
text: Noon, Boot: Boot your dude at the Town Square to draw two cards. If that dude has 2 or more influence, draw one additional card. Discard or ace a card in your hand.

name: 108 Righteous Bandits
text: Noon, Boot: Move your dude to the location of another of your Dudes (without booting, and even if booted).

name: Spirit Guidance
text: Noon Spirit 7, Boot: Discard a card to draw a card.  Noon Spirit 10, Boot: If this Shaman is not at your home, draw two cards, then discard two cards.

name: The Pack Awakens
text: Token dudes at this location gain the Harrowed keyword.  Shootout Spirit 8, Boot: A 2-stud Nature Spirit enters play, booted, and joins your posse.

name: Spirit Trail
text: This location is adjacent to each other location that has a Spirit Trail attached.  Noon Spirit 6, Boot: Move your dude from this location (without booting, and even if booted).

name: Many Speak as One
text: Noon, Spirit 9, Boot: Put a 1-Influence Ancestor Spirit Token in play at this location.

name: Spirit Dance
text: Shootout Spirit 10, Boot: A 2-stud Nature Spirit token enters play and joins your posse.

name: Ancestor Spirit
text: Cannot be included in decks.  Remove this token from the game if it leaves this location, or at the end of the turn.

name: Nature Spirit
text: Cannot be included in decks.  Remove this token from the game after this shootout.

name: Caitlin McCue
text: While Caitlin is at a Public location, your dudes are considered to have 1 less bounty. While Caitlin is at a Government deed, your Public deeds have +1 production.

name: Bethany Shiile
text: Each of your dudes with an Attire has +1 influence, +1 bullets and +1 value during High Noon.

name: Tyxarglenak
text: While Tyxarglenak is unbooted and has a Mystical goods, he has +2 bullets and all opposing Shootout actions must choose him if possible.

name: Dr. Dayl Burnett
text: Noon: Remove 1 bounty from an opposing dude to invent a Gadget without booting, reducing the difficulty of the Gadget by 3.

name: Maggie Harris
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark your home. If successful, search your discard pile for a Horse and attach it to any one of your dudes, reducing its cost by 1.

name: Emilia Vivirias
text: While Emilia is in a shootout, she gets a bonus to her bullets and Huckster skill equal to the number of Hexes she has attached. This bonus cannot exceed +4.

name: Professor Duncan
text: Duncan has +3 Shaman skill when casting Totems.

name: The Highbinder Hotel
text: Controller Shootout, Boot: Send your dude home booted.

name: 2nd Bank of Gomorra
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Place 2 ghost rock (from the bank) onto this deed.  Controller Noon, Boot: Move all ghost rock from this deed to your stash.

name: High Stakes Haven
text: Whenever the controller reveals an illegal draw hand, that player either pays 1 ghost rock or discards a random card.

name: Culpability Scientizer
text: After this is invented, give a dude 2 bounty.  Noon: Discard this card to call out a wanted dude at this location. If this results in a shootout, make a shootout play before the Winner makes the first play.

name: Espuelas
text: While this dude has a Horse, they have +1 influence.  Noon, Boot: If this dude has a Horse, move them to an adjacent location.

name: Rites of the Smoking Mirror
text: Noon: Ace this card to attach a Mystical goods to this dude (as shoppin'), reducing its cost by 4. The goods enter play booted.  Noon/Shootout: Discard this card to unboot a dude with a Mystical goods at this location.

name: Essence of Armitage
text: Can only be attached to Abominations. While this dude is in a shootout, non-Abomination dudes in the shootout have -1 bullets.  React, Boot: After an opposing dude flees this shootout, this dude permanently gains 1 control point.

name: Festering Grasp
text: Shootout Hex 13, Boot: Reduce an opposing dude's value by 6. If this would reduce their value below 1, ace them, then search your discard pile for a Sidekick and attach it to this dude, reducing its cost by 2.

name: Silver Pheasant's Bounty
text: Attaches only to deeds. This deed has +1 production.  Noon Spirit 6, Boot: Boot this deed to gain 2 ghost rock.

name: Comin' Up Roses
text: Resolution: Choose a card in your draw hand with no duplicate value in that hand. Change that card to the suit of your choice.  Cheatin' Resolution: Change one or two cards in your draw hand to the suit and value of your choice. Their new values cannot match another value in that hand. For the rest of the shootout, while your hand contains a legal flush or straight, you have +2 hand rank.

name: Run Rabbit Run
text: Shootout Technique: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. Search your discard pile for a Tao of the Jade Rabbit and add it to your hand. Whenever this dude moves during the shootout, they gain +1 bullets until the end of the shootout.

name: Putting the Pieces Together
text: Boot this card whenever you reveal an illegal draw hand. While this card is unbooted, increase your shootout hand rank by 1; if not, decrease it by 1.   Noon: Attach this card to your home, booted.

name: Someone Else's Problem
text: React: After you mark a location for a job, choose an opposing dude. That dude cannot join the mark's posse and is not affected by the job effects.

name: Lost to the Plague
text: This dude can only move to adjacent locations and home, and cannot boot to pay the cost of abilities.  Increase this dude's upkeep by 1 for each other Condition they have.  Noon: Attach to any dude with value 6 or lower.

name: Companhurst's
text: You may start this deed in play in place of a [108 SYMBOL] dude  While you are tied for the lowest ghost rock in your stash, you are considered to have less ghost rock than all other players.

name: Auto-Gatling
text: Once invented, attach this to your home or a deed you control.  This card's owner has a +2 stud bullet bonus during shootouts at this location. Unbooted dudes not controlled by this card's owner get -1 influence while at this location.

name: Heretic Joker (Red)
text: This card is only used for draw hands and pulls. You choose its suit and value. While this card is in your draw hand, your hand cannot be illegal. Decreases your hand rank by three.

name: Heretic Joker (Black)
text: This card is only used for draw hands and pulls. You choose its suit and value. While this card is in your draw hand, your hand cannot be illegal. Decreases your hand rank by three.

name: Ol' Howard
text: A deed with this card attached has 0 production and 0 control points, which cannot be modified.  React: At the start of the game, search your deck for a deed and play it, paying all costs. [DUDE] attaches to that deed, and permanently becomes a Condition and not a dude.

name: Market Street
text: While this deed is unbooted, increase the difficulty of skill tests made at this or adjacent locations by 1.  Controller Noon: Boot this deed.

name: Silent Sigil
text: The number of cards this deed's controller can discard at Sundown is reduced by one.  Controller React: After you refill your hand during Sundown, draw a card.

name: Notary Public
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Boot a Government or Public deed on this street that you own or control. If you booted a Government deed, give a dude 1 bounty. If you booted a Public deed, you may move one of your dudes (without booting).

name: Constance Daughtry
text: During High Noon, [DUDE] has +1 influence while at a Government deed.  React: After you resolve an ability printed on your home, unboot [DUDE]

name: Mahogany Jackson
text: Whenever [DUDE] joins a posse, discard the top two cards of your deck.

name: Gomorra Lot Commission
text: You may start with this deed in play in place of a dude  Controller Noon, Boot: Discard a deed from your hand to gain 1 ghost rock.You may move one of your dudes to a deed with a name that matches the discarded deed.

name: Requiem For A Good Boy
text: Resolution: Discard your Sidekick in this posse to reduce your casualties this round by two. Unboot the Sidekick's dude. Send an opposing dude home booted.

name: Crafty Hare
text: Shootout Spirit X, Boot: X is the highest value among opposing dudes in this shootout. This dude leaves the shootout and moves to another location. If this dude was the mark of a job, the job automatically fails after the shootout ends.

name: Framed
text: Noon: Choose an opposing dude. X is that dude's influence. That dude's controller either boots them and pays you 1 ghost rock, or else gives them 1 bounty.   Noon: X is 0. Give an opposing wanted dude 3 bounty.

name: Rhonda Sageblossom
text: [DUDE]'s Horse gains the Sidekick keyword.   Whenever you discard a Sidekick from [DUDE] to cover casualties, you may return it to your hand.

name: Wagner Memorial Ranch
text: You may start this deed in play in place of a [MCC SYMBOL] dude.  Controller React, Boot: Before your dude makes an invention skill test at this deed, reduce its difficulty by 2. If successful, unboot the dude.  If the invented gadget was a Horse or Improvement this deed gains +1 production permanently.

name: Fiddle Game
text: While this card is attached to your home, it has +2 production. Discard this card from your home after you have a Cheatin' Resolution ability used against you.  Noon Job: Mark your home. If successful, attach this card to your home.

name: Francisco Rosales
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark the town square. If successful, search your discard pile for a Sidekick or Horse and attach it to one of your dudes, reducing its cost by 2

name: Plague of Grasshoppers
text: Noon: Choose one or more of your unbooted Kung Fu dudes and a location. Each chosen dude that succeeds with a Kung Fu test moves to that location (without booting).

name: Epidemic Laboratory
text: Controller Noon Job, Boot: Your skilled dude leads a job marking this deed. If successful, this deed permanently gets +1 control points and +1 production.

name: Sunday Best
text: This dude has +3 Influence during the Upkeep phase.  React, Boot: At the start of the Upkeep Phase, move this dude to an adjacent location (without booting).

name: Sight Beyond Sight
text: Noon Hex 7, Boot: Look at up to two random cards in an opponent's hand. You may ace this card to ace a non-unique card you looked at.

name: Technological Exhibition
text: Noon Job: Your Mad Scientist leads a job that marks an in-town location. If successful, choose a gadget in your hand or discard pile. Your leader invents it without booting, reducing its difficulty and cost by 5. If you marked the town square, the gadget permanently gets one control point.

name: Carlton "Min" Rutherford
text: Noon, Pay 1 ghost rock: If you have less ghost rock in your stash than each other player, unboot [DUDE].

name: Walters Creek Distillery
text: Controller Noon,Boot: Boot a Saloon or Casino on this street that you own or control. If you booted a Casino gain 2 ghost rock. If you booted a Saloon, you may discard a card to draw a card.

name: A Piece Of The Action
text: Noon: Play a dude from your hand, reducing their cost by 4 to a minimum of 4. You may search your discard pile for a non-gadget goods and attach it to that dude, reducing its cost by the reduction in the dude's printed cost.

name: Foreboding Glance
text: Noon: Choose your dude and an opposing dude in the same location. If your dude has more control points, boot all cards attached to the opposing dude. If your dude has more influence, boot the opposing dude. If your dude has more bounty, call out the opposing dude.

name: Spirit Steed
text: Can only attach to a Shaman  Noon, Boot: Move this dude to the location of a Spirit (without booting).  Noon, Repeat: Boot a Spirit on this dude to move to another location.

name: Mountain Lion Friend
text: Your posse has an extra +1 draw bonus while this dude is in a shootout.  React: Before you take casualties, if this dude is in your posse, ace this card to reduce your casualties by two.

name: Ambrose Douglas
text: Noon: Discard a card to give [DUDE] +1 influence. If you discarded a spell or Mystical goods, you may unboot your home and use its ability an additional time this turn.

name: Lucretia Fanzini
text: While in the town square during an in-town shootout, [DUDE] may use abilities on [HIS/HER] Hymns as if [HE/SHE] were in your posse.

name: Turtle's Guard
text: Resolution Spirit 4, Boot: All dudes in your posse gain the Harrowed keyword until the end of this round. If your opponent has an illegal draw hand, a 2-stud Harrowed Nature Spirit enters play at this location and joins your posse.

name: Onward Christian Soldiers
text: Shootout Miracle 4, Boot: All dudes in your posse get +1 bullets, and cannot have their bullets reduced or changed to a draw by other player's card effects.

name: Pigging Out
text: Shootout Technique: Discard the top five cards of your deck. Search your discard pile for a Tao of the Zhu Bajie Technique and add it to your hand. Whenever this dude uses a technique that reduces an opposing dude's bullets, influence or value, reduce it by an additional 1.

name: Tusk
text: After this card enters play, draw a card.  This dude gets +5 value against opposing card effects.

name: Darragh Meng
text: After [DUDE] successfully casts a spell and the spell is still in play, discard it.

name: Fool Me Once...
text: While attached to your home, each other player draws a card whenever you reveal an illegal draw hand.  Cheatin' Resolution: Attach this card to the cheatin' player's home and draw three cards.

name: Henry Moran
text: If you are about to reveal an illegal draw hand during lowball and Scarface is unbooted, boot him, show the hand to the other players, then discard it and replace it with the top five cards of your deck.

name: Tallulah "Lula" Morgan
text: If your outfit is MCC Lula has -1 upkeep per control point you have.   Whenever you gain ghost rock from an ability during high noon (other than collecting bounty), gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Theo Whateley-Boyer
text: React, Pay 1 ghost rock: When discarding a lowball hand containing a Joker, attach the Joker to [DUDE] (it is not aced).  Resolution: Boot a hex on [DUDE] to discard a card from your draw hand and replace it with an attached joker.

name: Travis Moone
text: React, Boot: After an opponent draws a card via a card affect, draw two cards.

name: Back Ways
text: Noon: Move your wanted dude to another location (without booting).

name: Kyle Wagner
text: Noon, Boot: If Kyle is at a Ranch, unboot the Ranch. Its abilities may be used an additional time this turn.

name: Telepathy Helmet
text: If you are the Winner, this dude cannot be affected by other players' Shootout abilities.  Repeat Noon, 1GR: Look at a player's hand.

name: Town Council
text: Controller React, Boot: After you win lowball, choose your dude to get +3 influence until after the first High Noon play (including passing) is resolved

name: Faithful Hound
text: Shootout, Boot: Choose a goods in the opposing posse and pull. If the pull is lower than the value of the goods, discard the goods.

name: Plasma Drill
text: Noon, Pay 1 Ghost Rock, Boot this Dude: Choose a deed at an adjacent location. Its owner must pay ghost rock equal to its production. If they cannot or do not, discard the deed (any dudes there go home booted).

name: Slade Lighbody
text: React: After Slade fails a Hex pull, pull again and use that value instead. Ace the Hex after applying its effects (if any).

name: The R&D Ranch
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Gain 2 ghost rock and pull. If the pull is a club, discard this deed and all cards at this location.

name: Hired Help
text: Shootout: A 2-stud Gunslinger token enters play and joins your posse.

name: Rafi Hamid
text: Shootout: One or more of your Deputies in any location(s) joins your posse at a Government deed (moving if necessary).

name: Ulysses Marks
text: While Ulysses is at a Saloon, the Saloon gets 1 additional control point.  Noon: If Ulysses is at a Saloon, move another dude at the same location to the town square booted.

name: Paralysis Mark
text: Noon Hex X, Boot: X is the value of a dude at this or an adjacent location. Boot the dude.

name: Wylie Jenks
text: Wylie has +1 bullet for each wanted dude in the opposing posse.

name: Too Much Attention
text: Noon: Boot a wanted dude.  Noon:Boot a card worth one of more control points.

name: Make 'em Sweat
text: Shootout: Boot your dude to reduce another dude's bullet rating by your dude's bullet rating. If their bullet rating is now 0 boot them.

name: Forget
text: Noon Hex 5: Choose an ability printed on a Dude at this or an adjacent location. The Dude cannot use the ability until after Sundown.

name: Lillian Morgan
text: When Lillian enters a posse, place 3 ghost rock on her. The ghost rock may be used to pay for Shootout abilities (it is not a bounty). Discard her unused ghost rock after the shootout.  Shootout, Pay X Ghost Rock: X of your dudes in any location(s) join Lillian's posse (moving if necessary).

name: Alice Stowe
text: If one of your wanted dudes accepts a call-out, Alice may join the posse from any location (without booting, and even while booted).

name: Mr. Outang
text: Each of your Kung Fu dudes at this location with a Whiskey Flask or Baijiu Jar attached has +1 Kung Fu and is a stud.

name: Zui Waidan
text: Shootout: Boot your Saloon to give your dude +2 Kung Fu.

name: Stevie Lyndon
text: While casting Hymns, Stevie has +4 Blessed skill.

name: Eva Bright Eyes
text: Eva can only cast Totem and Sidekick Spirits.  Shootout: Boot Eva's Horse to send her home booted.

name: Wei Xu
text: While in a shootout, Wei Xu has +2 influence and +5 value.

name: Mick Aduladi
text: While at a Holy Ground location, Mick is a stud.  Noon: Move Mick to a Holy Ground location.

name: Hattie DeLorre
text: Shootout: One opposing wanted dude gets -5 bullets.

name: Father Tolarios
text: Discard a card. Choose an opposing wanted  dude at this or an adjacent location. Lower that dude's bounty by 1 to search  your deck or discard pile for a non-Unique Miracle or non-Unique Mystical  goods, reveal it, and add it to your hand.

name: Jimmy "The Saint"
text: While Jimmy is at a deed you control, you gain the production of that deed during Upkeep. If that deed is a Casino, gain an additional +1 production.

name: Mario Crane
text: Mario counts as "Sloane" for purposes of Uniqueness  Resolution, Repeat: If your hand is illegal, reduce your casualties this round by two. If your opponent has a legal hand, you take a minimum of 1 casualty. You can use this ability only once per shootout round.

name: POST-A-TRON
text: You may include POST-A-TRON in your starting gang.  If you do, you must invent it with a Mad Scientist from your starting gang after shuffling your deck.  Discard POST-A-TRON it you fail to invent it in this way.   Noon: Boot POST-A-TRON in the town square to gain 3 ghost rock.

name: Diego Linares
text: While inventing a Horse or a Sidekick, Diego has +4 Mad Scientist skill.

name: Christine Perfect
text: Noon: Move Christine to the location of the opposing dude with the highest grit (you choose in case of a tie). That dude gets -5 value.

name: Absalom Hotchkiss
text: React: After Absalom moves to the location of an Abomination, move one of your other dudes to this location.

name: The Caretaker
text: While The Caretaker hasn't moved this turn and is at a location you own, he has +4 bullets, +4 value, and is a stud.

name: Gomorra Gaming Commission
text: Cheatin' Resolution, Boot: This deed gains a permanent +1 production. Draw a card unless the cheatin' player pays you one ghost rock.

name: Sherman Mortgage
text: Boot this deed when a shootout starts.  While unbooted, increase the cost of each other player's deeds by 1 for every 4 deeds that player owns (round down).

name: Cliff's #4 Saloon
text: Noon, Boot: Your dude at this or an adjacent location you control becomes a stud.

name: Nickel Night Inn
text: Noon, Boot: Boot a dude with a value of 3 or less at this or an adjacent location.

name: Burn 'Em Out
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark an opponent's home.  Raise the bounty of each dude in your posse by 1.  If successful, look at that opponent's play hand and ace a card from it.

name: The Law Goes Underground
text: Boot or discard your stud dude. If that dude was a Deputy, send  the opposing shooter home booted. Send all dudes in your posse home booted.

name: Shiny Things
text: Noon: Choose an opposing dude. That dude gains +2 influence, +7 value, and may not be called out this turn. Boot the chosen dude.

name: Moving Forward
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Search your deck and discard pile for an in-town deed and play it, reducing its cost by 5. If played during lowball, pay ghost rock equal to the deeds production or discard it.

name: We Got a Beef!
text: React: After an unbooted dude accepts a callout, but before posses are formed, swap the location of either the mark or leader with a dude at an adjacent location controlled by the same player. The chosen dude replaces the original mark or leader in the shootout.

name: Baijiu Jar
text: While at a Saloon, this dude has +3 value and +1 influence  Shootout, Boot: Discard three cards to draw four cards.

name: De Annulos Mysteriis
text: Noon: Ace this card to search your discard pile for an action card that starts a job marking a location. Play the card, making this dude the leader if able. While leading the job, this dude has +1 bullets and is a stud.

name: Rancher's Lariat
text: While this dude is at a Ranch, that deed gains +2 production. It cannot receive a bonus from more than one Lariat.   Shootout, Boot: Choose an opposing dude. The dude cannot use their printed abilities. You may boot a Weapon on that dude.

name: Bowie Knife
text: You may attach this card to your dude in a posse (paying all costs) as a shootout play.   This dude is a stud. If there is an unbooted non-Melee Weapon in the opposing posse, Bowie Knife provides no bullet bonus and does not make this dude a stud.

name: Hydro-Puncher
text: This dude can attach two Weapons. If this dude is not a Gadget, both Weapons must be Melee. While this dude has two Weapons attached, they are a stud.   Shootout, Boot: Choose an opposing dude. Boot the dude and one of their attached cards.

name: Heartseeker
text: Shootout Hex 5, Boot: Reduce your opponent's casualties by three this round.  If you win this round, ace the opposing shooter.  This acing effect cannot be prevented (even if the shooter is Harrowed).

name: Amazing Grace
text: Noon Miracle 6, Boot: This Blessed gets +1 influence and does not go home booted the next time they refuse a callout. Your other dudes get +1 influence for purposes of controlling locations. Your dudes cannot have their influence reduced by opposing abilities.

name: Tse-Che-Nako's Weaving
text: This deed gains the Holy Ground keyword and does not unboot during Sundown.   Noon Spirit 7, Boot: Move one of your dudes to a location adjacent to this Shaman. You may unboot this deed to give this Shaman 1 control point until they move.

name: Great Sage Matching Heaven
text: Shootout Tao Technique: If successful, this dude gets +1 Influence and gains the Harrowed keyword. Combo if your posse has equal or higher influence than the opposing posse.

name: Two Hundred Fifty Rounds
text: Shootout Tao Technique: If successful, reduce your casualties this round by one. Combo if you control this location.

name: 108 Drunken Masters
text: Deeds at the ends of each street have the Saloon keyword.   React, Boot: After you reveal a pull for a Technique, reduce the pull by the amount of Saloons you control. If you succeed by 5 or more, you may add the pulled card to your hand.

name: Gateway to Beyond
text: Noon, Boot: Choose a number of your Spirits up to the number of Holy Grounds you control. Unboot them. You can use their abilities an additional time this turn.

name: Justice in Exile
text: When an opposing player reveals an illegal hand, they must raise the bounty on one of their dudes by 1. If your hand is legal, you choose the dude.   React, Boot: After an opposing wanted dude at the location of one of your Deputies leaves play during High Noon, gain 2 ghost rock. If they were discarded, you may ace them instead.

name: Protection Racket
text: Noon, Boot: Boot your dude at a deed to gain ghost rock equal to the number of deeds you control but do not own. If your opponents own fewer than three deeds total, gain 2 ghost rock. If you control at least three deeds you do not own, that dude gains a permanent control point and 1 bounty.

name: Morgan Regulators
text: When checking for victory, if there has not been a shootout this turn, each player's influence total at each location is limited to 5.   Noon, Boot: Choose your dude. Move them to the town square. That dude becomes a stud. If they have a Horse, unboot them.

name: Full Moon Brotherhood
text: Noon, Boot: Choose an opposing non-token dude that is adjacent to one of your dudes. That dude loses all traits, cannot move via card effects, and cannot refuse callouts. If that dude leaves play, either draw two cards or gain 2 ghost rock.

name: [Thunder Boy Nabbe]
text: Repeat Shootout: If there is a wanted dude in the opposing posse, Nabbe gets a bullet bonus equal to his influence and becomes a stud. You can use this ability once per shootout.

name: [Dave Slim Gorman]
text: React: After Dave casts a shootout hex, you may discard the Hex to have all dudes in the shootout become draws for this round.

name: 108 Gracious Gifts
text: While you have less ghost rock than each other player, you may discard an extra card at Sundown.  Noon, Pay 2 Ghost Rock, Boot: Unboot your dude.

name: Property Is Theft
text: After your opponent reveals a cheatin' hand during a shootout, they must pay the bank 1 ghost rock, if able. If your hand is legal, they pay you instead.  React, Boot: After you pay another player at least 1 ghost rock, draw a card. If this is a shootout, draw an additional card. You may discard 1 card, or up to 2 if this is a shootout.

name: The Spiritual Society
text: After refilling your hand during Sundown, if you have equal or more influence in town square than each other player, draw a card.  Noon, Boot: Boot your dude to boot an opposing dude with less influence at the same location.

name: Joe Vermilion
text: Noon: If Joe is at deed you do not own, pay the owner 1 ghost rock to gain ghost rock equal to that deed's production.

name: Ying-Ssi Chieh T'ang
text: Resolution: Pay the opposing posse's controller 1 ghost rock. Draw a card and place it in your draw hand. Discard a card from your draw hand.

name: E Gui
text: React: Before E Gui leaves play because you did not pay his upkeep, if E Gui is at a deed you do not own, boot the deed and gain ghost rock equal to the deed’s production.

name: Buskers
text: React: After an opposing dude moves to this location and that dude's controller has more ghost rock than you, that dude's controller must pay you 2 ghost rock. If they do not, boot that dude.

name: Taiyari
text: Shootout: Choose your dude. Pay the opposing posse's controller ghost rock equal to that dude's bullets to make that dude a stud. If that dude has 0 bullets, pay 1 ghost rock instead. That dude has a maximum bullet rating of 4.

name: Alexander Sequoia
text: While Alexander is in town square, you may discard an extra card from your hand at Sundown.  Noon: If Alexander is in town square, unboot Alexander.

name: Matthew Rising Sun
text: Matthew can cast Totems as if he had Shaman skill equal to his Kung Fu rating (he does not gain the Shaman keyword while casting a Totem).

name: Feichi Suitcase Lee
text: Shootout, Boot: Choose a dude in the posse opposing Feichi. Boot that dude. If Feichi has more influence than that dude, one of your other dudes at any location may join your posse (moving if necessary).

name: Geronimo
text: Noon: If Geronimo is not at your home, discard a card you do not own attached to Geronimo’s current location and gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Papa Marias
text: Noon: Choose your unbooted Huckster at another location and Marias makes a Huckster skill check of 7. If successful, move that Huckster to Marias's location.

name: Skinwalker
text: Shootout: Boot your Abomination dude. Either boot an opposing attachment at this location or give Skinwalker +2 bullets.

name: Tonton Macoute
text: Shootout: Choose an opposing dude. Give that dude -2 bullets or boot a Weapon on that dude.

name: Kevin Wainwright (Exp.1)
text: Noon/Shootout: Move Kevin to a location with a Huckster or Abomination dude. If this is a shootout play, the location must be the shootout location. Kevin joins your posse. Kevin becomes a stud and if there is an opposing dude with grit 11 or higher at that location, draw two cards.

name: Padre Ernesto de Diaz
text: After your opponent reveals a cheating hand, you may boot a miracle on Ernesto to draw a card

name: Dr. Erik Yaple
text: React: After posses are formed, boot a gadget weapon in your posse to give a dude without a bounty in the opposing posse 1 bounty.

name: Quincy Washburne
text: React: After Quincy successfully invents a Weapon Gadget, unboot him.

name: Xiong Wendy Cheng (Exp.1)
text: Opposing wanted dudes at Wendy’s location have -2 value.  Shootout, Boot: Choose an opposing dude. Send them home booted. If they have bounty greater than their grit, discard them.

name: Takahashi Jinrai
text: Noon Job: Mark an in-town deed you own whose cost is at least 2 ghost rock greater than its current production. If successful, the deed permanently gains +1 production.

name: Handsome Dan Deeds
text: Noon, Boot: If Dan is at in-town deed you own that has less than 2 control points, the deed gains a control point. After victory is checked during Sundown, if Dan has not moved, you may pay 4 ghost rock to make the control point permanent.

name: Vida Azul
text: Noon: Discard a card and choose a dude with a Horse at this or an adjacent location. Unboot that horse. Its abilities may be used an additional time this turn. If you discarded a Goods, you may unboot that dude.

name: Bartholomew P. Fountain
text: Noon, Boot: Boot your Ranch to move your dude at this or an adjacent location to another location you own or control.

name: Ike Clanton
text: Noon, Boot: Give a deed the Rowdy keyword. This effect lasts until after the next Upkeep phase. (Control of a Rowdy deed is checked with bullets instead of influence.)

name: Frank Stillwell
text: After Frank joins the mark's posse or a posse opposing a job, if he is wanted, he unboots.  React: After posses are formed, if Frank is in your posse, send him home booted.

name: Silas Aims (Exp.1)
text: Silas has a bullet bonus equal to his bounty, to a maximum bonus of 4.  Shootout, Boot: Send an opposing dude with less bullets than Silas's bounty home booted. If Silas is the mark, he ignores the boot cost of this ability.

name: Larry Sevens Swift
text: React: After posses are formed, if Larry is in your posse, boot Larry 's spell to boot an attachment in the opposing posse and increase Larry's bounty by 1. If you are not the Winner, Larry must be unbooted.

name: Virginia Ann Earp
text: While Virginia is in a shootout, hand ranks cannot be modified by Shootout, React, or non-Cheatin' Resolution abilities.

name: Campbell & Hatch Billiard Parlor
text: Controller React, Boot: After posses are formed, for the remainder of the shootout, hand ranks cannot be modified Shootout, React, or non-Cheatin' Resolution abilities. Dudes cannot be discarded or aced by Shootout or non-Cheatin' Resolution abilities during the first round.

name: Clanton Ranch
text: Noon, Boot: If you are not the Winner, gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Concordia Cemetery
text: Controller React, Boot: Before a non-token dude opposing your dude is aced in a shootout, give this deed a permanent +1 production. If that dude had grit 11 or higher, give this deed a permanent control point.

name: Ike's Place
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Choose a deed on this street or a deed you control. Reduce its control points and production to 0 until after the next Upkeep Phase.

name: Five Aces Gambling Hall
text: React, Boot: After posses are formed, if you own the mark, one of your wanted dudes joins your posse (moving if necessary).

name: Old Washoe Club
text: Controller Shootout, Boot: Send an opposing A-value dude home booted.   Controller Shootout, Boot: Discard a Sidekick.

name: Quarter Horse
text: React, Boot: After this dude’s posse succeeds at a job that didn’t mark your home, this dude stays at this location instead of going home booted.

name: Electrostatic Pump Gun
text: Shootout, Boot: Give an opposing dude -1 bullets. Pull. If the pull was not a club, the opposing dude becomes a draw if they have 0 bullets.

name: Claws
text: This dude is a stud.  This card cannot be attached or traded to a dude without the Harrowed or Abomination keyword. This card cannot be affected by opposing card effects.  If there is an unbooted non-Melee Weapon in the opposing posse, Claws provides no bullet bonus and does not make this dude a stud.

name: Analytical Cognisizer
text: After you invent this Gadget, unboot this Mad Scientist and draw a card.  React, Boot: After making a pull for a Gadget at this or an adjacent location, discard a goods card from your plan hand to make the pull's suit hearts.

name: Ranger's Bible
text: Cheatin’ Resolution, Boot: If your draw hand is legal this shootout round, lower a player’s hand rank by this dude’s influence, to a maximum reduction of 4.

name: Stone's Colt Dragoons
text: React, Boot: After an opposing dude joins this shootout by a card effect, boot that dude. That dude does not unboot at Sundown.

name: Bedazzle
text: Cheatin' Resolution Hex 3, Boot: Lower a player’s hand rank by 2. If this is a shootout, give an opposing dude a bullet penalty equal to their current bullets that lasts the remainder of the shootout.

name: Exultant Translocation
text: Noon Miracle 6, Boot: Choose your dude at a different location than this dude. This dude moves to the location of the other dude, and the other dude moves to the previous location of this dude. If you succeed by 6 or more, unboot one of the dudes.

name: Retribution
text: Shootout Miracle X, Boot: Choose an opposing dude. X is that dude's value. If that dude's controller reveals a cheating hand this round and you reveal a legal hand, ace that dude. This acing effect cannot be prevented.

name: Gateway
text: Noon Hex 6, Boot: Move your Abomination at this location to another location.  Shootout Hex 6, Boot: Your Abomination joins your posse (moving if necessary).

name: Guiding Wind
text: Shootout Spirit 8, Boot: Choose an opposing dude or your non-token dude. Set that dude’s bullets to equal to their influence, or 3, whichever is lower.

name: Mischievous Coyote
text: Shootout Spirit 9, Boot: Switch your total stud bonus and total draw bonus when making draw hands this round. You must have at least 1 non-token stud dude and 1 non-token draw dude in your posse to use this ability.

name: Murdered in Tombstone
text: Shootout: Your dude becomes a stud. Each posse’s controller may search their deck and discard pile for an action card with a Cheatin’ Resolution ability, reveal it, and add it to their hand. If a player added a card to their hand, they discard a card.

name: Hostile Takeover
text: Noon: Boot your stud at a deed you control but do not own. Boot that deed to gain ghost rock equal to your stud’s bullets, to a maximum of 3. You may ace this card to give that deed a permanent +1 control point and that dude a permanent +1 influence.

name: Jade King Stance
text: Noon Technique: Unboot this dude. They gain +2 Kung Fu, +2 bullets, and cannot move from this location.

name: Heist
text: Noon Job: Mark an in-town deed. Your posse must have 3 or more bullets. If successful, gain ghost rock equal to the mark's production and raise the leader's bounty by 2. If you do not own the mark, unboot your leader.

name: I'm Your Huckleberry
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Your opponent chooses a dude in their posse. That dude joins your posse under your control for the remainder of the shootout. After the shootout ends, if that dude is still in play, send that dude home booted. If your hand is legal, you choose the opposing dude.

name: Monkey Goes to the Mountain
text: Shootout Technique: If this dude is unbooted, choose an opposing dude with bullets equal to or less than this dude's Kung Fu rating. Move both dudes to an adjacent non-home location (without booting and even if booted). Both dudes leave the shootout.

name: Curse of Failure
text: This dude loses all keywords, traits, and abilities. This dude’s bullets, influence, and control points are equal to 0 and cannot be modified. This dude gets +1 upkeep. This card cannot be discarded by card effects.  Noon Job, Boot: Mark an opposing dude. If successful, discard all cards attached to the mark and send them home booted; attach this card to the mark.

name: Ricochet
text: Cheatin' Resolution: The cheating player discards their shooter. If your hand is legal, you do not take casualties this round and draw a card.

name: Andrew Lane
text: If you are the leader, your dudes without Weapons have -1 bullets.  Shootout, Boot: Attach a Non-Unique Weapon from your hand to one of your non-token dudes.

name: Hank Ketchum
text: If you are the leader, you must choose your highest grit dude in your posse as your shooter.  Resolution, Boot: If your posse only contains a single dude, and that dude has at least 1 printed influence, that dude gains Harrowed for this shootout round.

name: Lacy O'Malley
text: Card effects cannot cause cards to leave your discard pile, and cards in your discard pile cannot be played.  During Sundown, discard all cards in your hand.

name: The Tombstone Haint
text: The Haint has +2 influence during the Upkeep phase.

name: Rock Woofstone
text: Repeat Noon: Pay an opponent 1 ghost rock to move Rock to town square.

name: Arielle Moriah
text: React: After Arielle boots to use an ability on a Miracle, unboot her.

name: Gabriel Prior
text: Increase Gabriel's Blessed skill checks by the number of your other dudes at this location.

name: Mr. Baird
text: Noon, Pay 1 Ghost Rock, Boot: Discard a deed from your play hand to put an in-town deed from your discard pile into your play hand.

name: Harlan Stanton
text: Harlan is a stud while at a Ranch.  Shootout: If this shootout is at a Ranch, Harlan joins your posse (moving if necessary).

name: Dr. Delphi Wallis
text: Shootout: Boot Delphi or her Gadget to make a Mad Scientist skill check against an opposing dude's grit. If successful, choose an ability printed on that dude. That dude cannot use the ability until after the Sundown phase.

name: Cooper Grannon
text: Noon: Boot Cooper's Gadget to pull. If the Gadget is Experimental make an additional pull. For each pull, if it is a:   * Diamond, draw a card then discard a card * Heart, Cooper gains +2 bullets * Spade, Coop gains +1 influence * Club, boot Cooper

name: Vivene Goldsun
text: If Vivene has a Mystical goods, she is a stud.  Shootout, Boot: Discard one of Vivene's Mystical goods to choose an opposing dude with grit lower than that goods' value. Send that dude home booted.

name: Maurice Croker
text: Shootout: If there are no studs in your posse, choose an opposing dude. That dude becomes a draw.

name: Bogie Man
text: While you have no dudes in Boot Hill, Bogie Man has +1 influence.  Bogie Man gains a bullet bonus equal to the highest printed influence in any Boot Hill.

name: Evan Lucas
text: If Evan Lucas is in your posse, you gain 1 ghost rock whenever an opposing dude is aced.

name: Tawodi
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark the town square. If successful, choose a dude or deed in your discard pile and play it, lowering the cost by 2, to a minimum of 1.

name: Tsintah
text: Shootout: Boot Tsintah's Spirit or a Totem at this location to make her a stud. If this location is Holy Ground, or is a deed adjacent to Holy Ground, Tsintah gets +1 bullets.

name: Jackie Sanjuro
text: Jackie cannot have non-Melee Weapons attached.   While Jackie is the only dude in your posse, he has +4 value and is a stud.

name: Speaks-with-Buffalo
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark an opposing dude. Speaks-with-Buffalo becomes a stud. When forming draw hands this shootout, all dudes use their influence instead of bullets to determine how many cards each player draws (but keep their bullet types). If successful, unboot Speaks-with-Buffalo, draw 2 cards, and then discard 2 cards.

name: Judge Wells Spicer
text: Noon, Boot: Send an opposing dude at this location with more bounty than influence home booted. That dude's owner may reduce that dude's bounty to 0.

name: Joan McGruder
text: Joan has -1 bullets for each other dude in her posse.  Joan cannot flee or be sent home from a shootout.  Joan's attached cards cannot affect opposing dudes unless they have bounty higher than their influence.

name: Virgil Earp
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Choose up to three bounty on dudes in the opposing posse. If your hand is legal, you may choose up to five bounty. Lower your opponent's hand rank by that amount. Your opponent may remove the chosen bounty.

name: Marshal Caves Callarman
text: Caves has -1 bullets and -1 influence for each bounty he has.  Noon: If Caves is at a Public location, discard a card to reduce his bounty by 1.

name: Florentino Indian Charlie Cruz
text: Charlie has a +1 value for each bounty he has.  While Charlie's bounty is greater than 3, he cannot be changed to a draw.

name: Tomas Ramirez
text: Shootout: Boot Tomas's Hex to make a Huckster skill check against the value of an opposing Weapon. If successful, discard both the booted Hex and the Weapon.

name: Pete Spence
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark an in-town location Pete is not at. If successful, choose an Attire or non-Unique Weapon in your discard pile and attach it to one of your dudes, booted (paying all costs). If that dude attached a Weapon and has no bounty, raise their bounty by 1.

name: Jonah Essex (Exp.1)
text: If your outfit is Outlaws, Jonah's cost is reduced by the number of different Hexes you control.  Other wanted dudes in Jonah's posse have +1 bullets.  Noon/Shootout: Discard an opponent's attached card at this location with cost equal to or less than Jonah's bounty. Raise the bounty of your dude at this location by 1.

name: Camillus S. Fly
text: React: After Camillus enters play during High Noon, one of your other dudes becomes a stud.

name: QUATERMAN PRIME
text: QUATERMAN PRIME must be invented, and enters play at the Mad Scientist's location.  QUATERMAN PRIME'S bullets cannot be modified except by his attached goods. Cards cannot boot or move QUATERMAN PRIME.   Each time a player reveals a cheatin' hand in QUATERMAN PRIME'S shootout, that player takes an additional casualty.

name: Winona Rein-Breaker
text: Shootout, Pay 1 Ghost Rock, Boot: Discard an opposing Sidekick.

name: Nicole Sumner
text: While Nicole is wanted, she has +3 bullets.  When Nicole is wanted, her influence is reduced to 0.  React: After you win lowball, reduce Nicole's bounty to 0.

name: Red River Roulette
text: Resolution, Boot: If your hand is legal, boot your dude at this deed to prevent all casualties this round. Dudes cannot flee this round. In the next round of the shootout, double the number of casualties inflicted.

name: Kiva of Fathomless Reach
text: React, Boot: After victory is checkec during Sundown, move your dude to town square.

name: Crystal Palace
text: Abomination dudes at this location have +1 bullets and +1 influence.

name: Rham's Readings
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Reveal the top card of an opponent's deck. If that has the same value or suit as the top card in their discard pile, gain 1 ghost rock. If a joker is revealed, ace it and reveal the next card.

name: Jonah's Retreat
text: The player who controls Jonah's Retreat collects its production.

name: Schieffelin Hall
text: When forming draw hands during shootouts at this location, all dudes use their influence instead of bullets to determine how many cards each player draws (but keep their bullet type).

name: Blue Lightnin'
text: This dude is a stud.  Repeat Shootout: Boot this dude's Hex. This dude gets +1 bullets or +1 Huckster skill.

name: Magnum Rounds
text: Shootout: This dude gets +1 bullets. If you reveal a legal draw hand this round, hand ranks can only be modified by traits and Cheatin' Resolutions. Discard this card.

name: Iron Mole
text: If Iron Mole is at an Out of Town deed, increase that deed's production by 1.  Noon, Boot: Move this dude to an Out of Town deed.  Shootout, Boot: If this dude is at an Out of Town deed, this dude joins your posse (moving if necessary).

name: Net Gun
text: Shootout, Boot: This dude makes a Mad Scientist skill check against an opposing dude's value. If successful, discard this card and and make that dude a draw.

name: Scratch
text: If Scratch is discarded from play, discard a card to draw a card.  Noon/Shootout, Boot: Move Scratch to another of your dudes at an adjacent location.

name: Battered Banjo
text: React, Boot: After a Hymn is successfully cast at this location, this dude gains +1 influence.  Noon, Boot: Discard this card to give an opposing dude at this location -2 bullets.

name: Bolts o' Doom
text: Shootout Hex 7, Boot: Reduce an opposing dude's bullets by this dude's influence. If that dude has 0 bullets, this dude gets +1 bullets.

name: Lethargy
text: Noon Hex X, Boot: X is the grit of an unbooted dude at this or an adjacent location. At sundown, that dude does not unboot unless their controller pays 1 ghost rock.

name: Mind Twist
text: Noon/Shootout Hex 6, Boot: Boot a spell attached to a dude at this location. If this is a shootout, the spell must be in the opposing posse.  Noon Hex 6, Boot: Choose a dude at this location. Until after Sundown, that dude's influence is set to 1 (and cannot be modified).

name: Dies Irae
text: Shootout Miracle 8, Boot: After choosing your shooter this round, up to four dudes in your Boot Hill contribute bullets to your draw and stud bonus (as back-up dudes). Your dudes cannot flee the shootout this round.

name: Babble On
text: React Miracle 6: After another Miracle boots your dude, unboot that dude.  Shootout Miracle 7, Boot: Boot this dude to boot an opposing card.

name: Ancestor's Reproach
text: Shootout Spirit 8, Boot: Ace a card from your hand. An Ancestor Spirit enters play at this location and joins your posse.   Cheatin' Resolution Spirit 6, Boot: An Ancestor Spirit enters play at this location and joins your posse.

name: Secret Paths
text: Noon Spirit 8, Boot: Move all of your unbooted dudes at this location to another location.

name: Fannin' the Hammer
text: Shootout: Boot your dude to choose a number of opposing dudes equal to your dude's bullet rating. Each chosen dude with 0 printed bullets becomes a draw. Each chosen dude gets -1 bullets.

name: Tumblebleeds!
text: During shootouts at this location, the losing posse takes an additional casualty.  Each player gains the ability: \Noon Job: Mark the town square. If successful, discard a number of attached Tumblebleeds! equal to the number of dudes in your posse.\   Noon: Boot your Huckster to attach this card to town square.

name: Takin' Cover
text: Shootout: Give one of your dudes -1 bullets. That dude cannot be chosen as a casualty this round unless you lose this shootout round by 3 or more ranks.

name: Hell's Comin' With Me!
text: Shootout: One of your dudes joins your posse (moving if necessary). If that dude has a Sidekick, you may make another shootout play with one of that dude's attached cards.

name: Frontier Feud
text: Noon: Move your unbooted in-town dude to town square and boot them. Your opponent must either give that dude 1 permanent control point, or move one of their in-town dudes to town square and call out that dude. No other dudes may join this shootout.

name: Seizing the Pearl of Death
text: Cheatin' Resolution Technique: Draw a card. You may send a dude at this location home booted. If this is a shootout, reduce your casualties by 1 and increase your opponent's casualties by 1. If your hand is legal, this dude gets +1 bullets and +1 influence until Sundown.

name: Leonardo "Leon" Cavallo
text: Noon, Boot: Make a Huckster skill check against the value of a dude at this or an adjacent location. If successful, boot that dude.

name: Richard Slavin
text: Noon, Boot: If Richard is out of town, pull. If the pull is red, search your discard pile or Boot Hill for a Mystical goods and add it to your hand.

name: Mortimer Parsons
text: If Mortimer is in your posse when you reveal an illegal draw hand, send him home booted and reduce his influence to 0 until after Sundown. If you have no other dudes in your posse, the shootout immediately ends.

name: Gang Yi
text: Shootout: Swap this dude with any of your dudes in a Shootout where the other player's posse has one or more dudes with a bounty.

name: Tallulah "Lula" Morgan
text: Noon Boot, Pay 1 Ghost Rock: Gain ghost rock equal to the production of a deed you control, but do not own.

name: Dr. Emanuel Ashbel
text: React: When a dude is aced, pull. If the pull is higher than the dude's value, discard them instead.

name: Angelica Espinosa
text: Shootout: Angéca joins a posse at an adjacent location without moving or booting.

name: Jose Morales
text: While in a shootout, Joséains a bonus to his Huckster skill equal to his bullet rating.

name: Genesee "Gina" Tailfeathers
text: React, Boot: At the start of the game, discard a card from your play hand to draw 2 cards.

name: Mario Crane
text: If you reveal a legal draw hand, Mario cannot be chosen as a casualty unless you lose this shootout round by 3 or more ranks.

name: Hustings
text: All dudes not controlled by this deed's controller have -1 influence while unbooted at home.

name: Surveyor's Office
text: This deed is considered adjacent to all out of town deeds.  Controller Noon, Boot: Move your dude from this location to an adjacent location.

name: Baird's Build and Loan
text: Controller Noon, Boot: Play a deed (as shoppin'), reducing its cost by 2 ghost rock.

name: Ballot Counter
text: This dude gets an influence bonus equal to the number of influence counters on this card. Discard all influence counters on this card at the end of the Upkeep phase.  Repeat Noon, Pay 1 Ghost Rock: Add an influence counter to this card.

name: Holy Wheel Gun
text: Shootout, Boot: Choose an opposing dude. That dude gets -1 bullets. If that dude is an Abomination, they must be chosen as the first casualty (if possible).

name: Stone Idol
text: Noon/Shootout, Boot: Give a target dude -3 Value (to a minimum of 1)

name: Corporeal Twist
text: Shootout Hex 4, Boot: One opposing dude gets -1 bullets and -2 value. If that dude is aced or discarded during this shootout, this Huckster permanently gains 1 control point.

name: Fetch
text: Cheatin' Resolution Hex 5, Boot: You may place a card from your draw hand into your play hand after resolution. If this is a shootout, you suffer 3 less casualties this round.

name: ..It's who you know
text: Noon: One of your dudes calls out an opposing dude at their location. All dudes in both posses use their influence rather than their bullet rating for the shootout (but keep their bullet type). Your dude becomes a stud for this shootout.

name: Horse Wranglin'
text: Noon: Search your deck and/or discard pile for a Horse. Attach it to one of your unbooted dudes (paying all costs).

name: It's Not What You Know...
text: Resolution: Lower a player's draw hand by 1 rank.  Cheatin' Resolution: Lower a player's draw hand by 4 ranks.

name: Shizeng Lu
text: While your stash has less ghost rock than each other player and another player owns this location, Shizeng Lu is worth +1 control point, and this location has -2 control  points and does not unboot during the Sundown phase.

name: Forster Cooke
text: While Forster is at a Saloon or Casino, your other dudes have +1 bullets and +1 value.

name: Joseph Dusty Hill
text: While Joseph has a Spirit, he has +1 influence.   While Joseph has an Attire, he has +1 bullets and +2 Shaman skill.

name: Mariel Lewis
text: Shootout: If your posses has higher total influence than the opposing posse, remove a dude from the opposing posse and send them home without booting.

name: The Tattooed Man
text: Whenever an ability discards a Hex on The Tatooed Man, you may place it into your hand instead.    Whenever an ability aces a Hex on The Tatooed Man, you may place it into your discard pile instead.

name: Riorden O'Lithen
text: Noon: Boot a spell attached to Riorden to give a dude at this or an adjacent location 1 bounty. Discard the spell if the dude was not wanted when you used this ability.

name: Lucky Sky Borne
text: You may include a Sidekick goods in your starting posse as if it were a dude, and attach it to Sky at the start of the game. If it's a Gadget, shuffle your deck, and Sky invents it as normal.

name: Miranda Clarke
text: While Miranda has a control point, she has +2 influence.    While Miranda has at least 2 bounty, she has +2 bullets.

name: Elliot Smithson
text: React: After goes home booted following a successful job initiated by a dude's ability or an action card, unboot your leader and gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Shelby Hunt
text: Shootout: If a dude in the opposing posse has higher bullets than Shelby, Shelby gains +1 bullets, is a stud, and cannot be affected by other players' Shootout abilities.

name: The Joker's Smile
text: Whenever a joker is aced during lowball, the controller gains 1 ghost rock.  Controller Noon, Boot: Discard a joker to gain 1 ghost rock and draw a card.  Controller Noon, Boot: Pay 1 ghost rock to move a joker from your Boot Hill to your discard pile.

name: Old Marge's Manor
text: The controller can use ghost rock on this deed to pay for action cards or gadget abilities during shootouts.    React, Boot: Before making a play, move all ghost rock counters (not bounty) from a card you control to this deed.    Noon, Boot: Place 1 ghost rock on this deed.

name: Xemo's Turban
text: Repeat Noon, Boot: Pull. If the pull is not a club you may pay 1 ghost rock to draw a card, discard a card, and unboot Xemo's Turban.

name: Blight Serum
text: While this card is attached to a deed, after a dude moves here, move that dude home booted and ace this card.    Noon, Boot: Attach this card to this deed.

name: Guide Horse
