text: Noon Spirit X, Boot: X is the value of a dude at this location. Boot that dude. Shootout Spirit X, Boot: X is the grit of an opposing dude. Send that dude home booted.

name: Spirit Trail
text: This location is adjacent to each other location that has a Spirit Trail attached. Noon Spirit 6, Boot: Move your dude from this location (without booting, and even if booted).

name: Many Speak As One
text: Noon Spirit 9, Boot: Put a 0-draw, 1-influence Ancestor Spirit token into play at this location.

name: Ghostly Communion
text: Your outfit is considered a Holy Ground while casting this spell. Noon Spirit 5, Boot: Move this dude to a Holy Ground or a location adjacent to one. Shootout Spirit 7, Boot: This dude joins your posse at a Holy Ground or a location adjacent to one. This dude becomes a stud.

name: Fire of Nanahbozho
text: Can only attach to a deed. This deed gains Holy Ground. Shamans get +2 Shaman while at a deed with one or more of this Totem. Noon/Shootout Spirit 10, Boot: Unboot a dude at a nearby deed. If that dude is at this deed, make another play.

name: Establishin' Who's in Charge
text: Noon Job: Mark an in-town deed. If successful, give the deed 1 permanent control point.

name: Make 'Em Sweat
text: Shootout: Boot your dude to reduce another dude's bullet rating by your dude's bullet rating. If their bullet rating is 0 (or less), boot them.

name: Polite Inquiries
text: Noon: Boot your dude at a location other than home. Draw cards up to your dude's bullet rating (maximum 4), then discard the same number of cards. Draw a card.

name: Bottom Dealin'
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Discard the cheatin' player's draw hand and replace it with the top five cards of your deck (those cards still go to your discard pile).

name: Make the Smart Choice
text: Shootout: Reduce a dude's bullets by their influence. That dude's controller may send them home booted (even if already booted).

name: Mugging
text: Noon Job: Mark an opposing dude. Boot up to two cards attached to the mark. If the job is successful, send the mark home booted, and you may ace up to two booted cards attached to the mark.

name: Zhu's Ferocity
text: Shootout Tao Technique: This dude gets +1 bullets and +1 value, and an opposing dude gets -1 bullets. Combo if this dude has higher bullets than the opposing dude.

name: ...It's Who You Know
text: Noon: One of your dudes calls out an opposing dude at their location. If accepted, your dude becomes a stud for this shootout. When forming shootout hands this shootout, all dudes use their influence instead of bullets to determine how many cards each player draws (but keep their bullet type).

name: Raking Dragons
text: Shootout Tao Technique: Boot a dude and give them -2 value. Combo if that dude has lower value than this dude.

name: The Stakes Just Rose
text: Shootout: One of your dudes joins your posse and becomes a stud.

name: Sun in Yer Eyes
text: Shootout: Target dude in this shootout gets -2 bullets or becomes a draw. You may spend 1 ghost rock to give both effects to that dude.

name: Ambush
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark an opposing dude. If the mark is not wanted, raise the bounty on each dude in your posse by 1. If successful, ace the mark.

name: Belligerence
text: Noon: Give a wanted dude +1 bullets and +1 influence until Noon next turn. Noon, Pay 1 Ghost Rock: Give a dude 1 bounty to unboot them.

name: Coachwhip!
text: Cheatin' Resolution: The cheatin' player boots one of their dudes. If this is a shootout, the dude is aced instead. If your hand is legal, you choose the target instead.

name: Rabbit's Lunar Leap
keywords: Technique • Tao of the Jade Rabbit
text: Shootout Tao Technique: This dude joins your posse. You may unboot this dude. Combo if your posse does not have more dudes than the opposing posse.

name: Hiding in the Shadows
text: Noon: Target one of your dudes. Other players cannot target or affect that dude with Shootout abilities.

name: Ol' Fashioned Hangin'
text: Noon Job: Mark an opposing dude with at least 2 bounty. If successful, ace the mark, and your leader (if still in play) gets 1 permanent control point.

name: Pistol Whip
text: Shootout: Boot your dude in this posse to send a dude in the other posse home booted. Your dude gets -1 bullets (minimum 0).

name: Rabbit's Deception
keywords: Technique • Tao of the Jade Rabbit
text: Shootout Tao Technique: Send this dude home booted. If they were unbooted when you played this card, you may also send an opposing dude home booted. Combo if there is a stud in the opposing posse.

name: Calling the Cavalry
text: Shootout: During this round's resolution, the player with the most Horses in their posse gains +1 hand rank. One dude in your posse becomes a stud until the end of the shootout.

name: Faster on the Draw
text: Shootout: Give your dude +1 bullets. If they are a Deputy, they become a stud. Give one opposing dude - 2 bullets.

name: Great Sage Matching Heaven
keywords: Technique • Tao of Bull Demon King
text: Shootout Tao Technique: This dude gets +1 Influence and gains the Harrowed keyword. Combo if the other posse has less influence than your posse.

name: Technological Exhibition
text: Noon Job: Mark an in-town location. Your leader must have Mad Scientist. If successful, your leader invents a Gadget in your hand or discard pile without booting, reducing its cost and difficulty by 5. If you marked the town square, give the Gadget +1 control points permanently.

name: Comin' Up Roses
text: Resolution: Choose a card in your draw hand with no duplicate value in that hand. Change the card to the suit of your choice. Cheatin' Resolution: Change one or two cards in your draw hand to the suit and value of your choice. Their new values cannot match another value in that hand. For the rest of the shootout, while your hand contains a legal flush or straight, you have +2 hand rank.

name: Kidnappin'
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark an opposing dude. Your posse must have more total bullets than the marked dude. Give 1 bounty to each dude that joins your posse during the job. If successful, discard the mark.

name: Pinned Down
text: Shootout: Target dude must be selected as the first casualty. If they are chosen as a shooter, they get -3 bullets.

name: Two Hundred Fifty Rounds
keywords: Technique • Tao of Bull Demon King
text: Shootout Tao Technique: Reduce your casualties this round by one. Combo if you control this location.

name: Bounty Hunter
text: Noon: A 2-stud Gunslinger token enters play at a wanted dude's location and calls out that dude, who cannot refuse.

name: Ridden Down
text: Noon: Boot your horse to send a dude without a Horse at that location home booted.

name: This'll Hurt in the Morning'
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Discard one or two cards of your choice in an opponent's cheatin' hand. Replace them with cards drawn from their owner's deck. If your hand is legal, then for each card discarded, your opponent must either pay you 1 ghost rock or ace the card.

name: Rabbit's Sweeping Snare
keywords: Technique • Tao of the Jade Rabbit
text: Shootout Tao Technique: Mark an opposing dude. That dude becomes a draw. If your posse has fewer dudes than the opposing posse, boot up to two cards attached to that dude.

name: Ricochet
text: Cheatin' Resolution: The cheating player discards their shooter. If your hand is legal, you do not take casualties this round and draw a card.

name: Shortcut
text: Noon: Move your unbooted dude to another location. React: When forming a posse at an adjacent location, target dude does not boot to move to the shootout's location.

name: Trick Shooting
text: Shootout: Give your dude +1 bullets. Pull. If the pull is red, look at a number of cards from the top of your deck equal to your dude's bullet rating and put one of them into your hand.

name: Crushing Inevitability
text: Shootout Tao Technique, Boot: Target an opposing dude. If that dude is booted, they do not contribute to draw hands this round. If the mark has a lower value than this dude, then they must be selected as the first casualty this round.

name: Recruitment Drive
text: Noon Job: Mark the town square. If successful, put a dude or deed into play from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 5 ghost rock.

name: Too Much Attention
text: Noon: Boot a wanted dude. Noon: Boot a card worth one or more control points.

name: Unprepared
text: Shootout: Boot a dude and give them -1 bullets. They cannot use their abilities. Shootout: Boot up to 2 cards attached to a dude. Those cards lose all traits, abilities, and bullet bonuses.

name: Flight of the Lepus
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Target up to two dudes controlled by you or the cheatin' player. If you revealed a legal hand, you may target one additional dude. Move those dudes home. If this is as shootout, you may boot them.

name: Meet the New Boss
text: Noon Job: Mark the town square. If successful, your leader gains 1 permanent control point. You may ace this card to give your successful leader a permanent +1 influence.

name: Outgunned
text: Resolution: If your posse has higher total bullets than the opposing posse, boot your shooter to increase your hand rank by 2.

name: It's Not What You Know...
text: Resolution: Lower a player's hand rank by 1. Cheatin' Resolution: Lower a player's hand rank by 4.

name: No Turning Back
text: Noon: Ace a dude you own and control to gain ghost rock equal to their cost. Resolution: Ace a dude you own and control to reduce your casualties this round to zero. Target dude gets +2 bullets and becomes a stud until the end of the shootout. Your dudes cannot flee this round.

name: Thirst for Blood
text: Shootout: Target your dude with 1 or more influence. That dude becomes a stud or gains +2 bullets; you may increase their bounty by 1 to gain both bonuses instead. Reduce that dude's influence by 1 until after Sundown.

name: Election Day Slaughter
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark the town square. Each other player may unboot a dude in town. If successful, each other player must ace one of their dudes in town.

name: Nightmare at Noon
text: Shootout: Give each dude in one posse -1 bullets. Each dude in the shootout with 0 or 1 bullets becomes draw.

name: Point Blank
text: Resolution: Boot your non-token stud dude in this posse. Your opponent must ace a dude in their posse with lower bullets than your dude's bullets.

name: Joker (black)
text: This card is only used for draw hands and pulls.    You choose its suit and value. Ace the joker after use.

name: Joker (red)
text: This card is only used for draw hands and pulls.    You choose its suit and value. Ace the joker after use.

name: Ancestor Spirit
text: Cannot be included in decks. Remove this token from the game if it leaves this location, or at the end of the turn.

name: Gunslinger
text: Cannot be included in decks. Remove this token from the game after this shootout.

name: Buzz Crover
text: Buzz has a bullet bonus equal to the number of nearby locations where you have another dude. This bonus cannot exceed +4.

name: Yuan Min
text: Yuan cannot attach Weapons. Shootout: Discard a card to search your discard pile for a Tao Technique, reveal it, and add it to your hand.

name: Lu Feng
text: Noon, Boot: Boot this deed or another dude at Lu Feng's location.

name: Anthony Shepherd
text: While you have 0 ghost rock in your stash, Anthony is a stud.

name: Kassandra Nilsson
text: Noon/Shootout: Move Kassandra to the location of one of your Horses. If this is a shootout play, the location must be the location of the shootout, and Kassandra joins your posse.

name: Obadiah Angstrom
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark an In Town deed an opponent owns. If successful, pull; if the pull is red, discard the deed from play.

name: Howling Howell Melton
text: Noon, Boot: Call out an opposing dude at this location, whose controller must pay you 1 additional ghost rock to refuse. No other dudes may join this shootout. This shootout ends after one round. Reduce casualties on both sides by 2. If no dude is aced, the winner gains 2 ghost rock.

name: Roger Wilcox
text: Roger cannot attach Gadgets.    Roger gets +2 bullets if there is a Gadget at this location.

name: Empty Schell
text: React: After Empty Schell is chosen as a casualty, send an opposing dude home from the shootout.

name: Fred Ayres
text: While Fred has a Mystical goods, he gets  +1 bullets and +1 influence.    Noon: Boot Fred's attached Mystical goods to look at the top card of your deck.

name: Alonzo
text: Noon: Discard a Hex attached to Alonzo to draw a card.

name: Danny London
text: Your Abomination dudes at nearby locations do not gain bounty for joining a posse at another player's Private Location. Shootout: Target an Abomination dude in your posse. Change Danny's bullet type to the same as that dude's. If Danny has a lower bullet rating, he gets a bullet bonus equal to the difference in ratings. If he has a higher bullet rating, he suffers a penalty equal to the difference instead.

name: Ghost Dancers
text: Ghost Dancers can have one Totem attached. If Ghost Dancers are at a deed, a Totem attached to them is considered to be planted at that deed. Noon: If Ghost Dancers are unbooted at a location you control, and you have an unbooted Shaman there, attach a Totem to Ghost Dancers.

name: SuAnne Bettelyuon
text: SuAnne cannot leave a shootout due to card effects. Repeat Shootout: Discard a card to make SuAnne a stud. If you discarded a Technique, give SuAnne +1 bullets and +1 value. You can use this ability once per shootout.

name: Dakota Katzeek
text: Noon, Boot: If Dakota is at a deed, discard a card to search your discard pile for a Totem, reveal it, and add it to your hand. You may immediately plant it at this deed (ignoring unbooted Shaman and control requirements).

name: Charley Bull
text: Shootout: Reduce an opposing dude's bullets by Charley's Influence.

name: Amity Hopkins
text: Noon: Boot a wanted dude at this location.

name: Stan Fredricks
text: Shootout: If Stan is wanted, move one bounty from him to an opposing dude. Send Stan home from the shootout, booted.

name: Thunder Boy Nabbe (Exp.1)
text: Shootout: Boot Thunder Boy or a Blessed in your posse to make an opposing wanted dude a draw.

name: Dr. Shane Tilton
text: Shootout: Boot an opposing dude. If that dude is an Abomination, Dr. Tilton gets +2 bullets.

name: Kim Lloyd
text: Noon: Move your wanted dude from this location to an adjacent deed to make Kim a stud.

name: Felix Cutler
text: Resolution: If your hand is cheatin', unboot a Hex or goods in your posse. Its abilities may be used an additional time this turn.

name: Frank Bryant
text: React: When Frank enters play, give him 1 bounty. Dudes with less bounty than Frank cannot refuse his callouts.

name: Christine Perfect (Exp.1)
text: While Christine is a member of a posse attempting a job, she is a stud.

name: TLC John Yarbrough
text: Noon / Shootout: Discard a Sidekick or Horse at this location to give TLC John +1 bullets, +1 Influence and make them a stud. If you discarded your Sidekick or horse, Reduce TLC John's upkeep to 0 until after the next Upkeep phase.

name: James Bogue
text: React: After your posse containing James suffers 1 or more casualties in a shootout, James gets +1 bullets for the rest of the shootout.

name: Carmilla
text: Noon: Target an opposing dude at this location. Carmilla makes a Huckster skill check of that dude's grit. If successful, boot that dude. If unsuccessful, boot Carmilla (if able).

name: Agent Moquin
text: React, Boot: If Moquin is in your posse, after an opponent declares the use of a Shootout ability on an action card with no printed ghost rock cost, cancel that ability (the card is discarded without effect).

name: Coinneach "Ken" Càrn
text: While in Town Square, Ken is worth 1 Control point for every faction among dudes you control.

name: Smith Family Farm
text: This deed is worth +1 control points while there is an unbooted dude here.    Noon: Boot your dude at this deed to draw a card and gain 2 ghost rock.

name: Livery Stables
text: Shootout, Boot: Give a dude with a Horse +1 or -1 bullets.

name: Worm Canyon
text: Noon, Boot: Discard your hand, then gain one ghost rock for each card discarded.

name: Dispatch Office
text: React, Boot: When a dude gains bounty for joining a shootout at another player's Private location, increase or decrease that dude's bounty by 1.

name: Carson's Cantina
text: React, Boot: After your opponent reveals a Cheatin' hand, you may draw a card or gain 1 Ghost Rock.

name: The Veiled Crossing
text: This deed is adjacent to all other Holy Grounds.

name: Tai Chi Chuan Garden
text: React, Boot: After you succeed with a pull, draw a card and discard a card.

name: The Father's Cross
text: If this dude is Blessed, increase their Blessed rating by 1.

name: Rattler-Hide Coat
text: This dude gets +3 value..  While this dude is at a deed, they use their bullet rating to determine control of the deed instead of their influence.

name: Jacc's Fail Safe
text: This dude gets +2 influence during the Production and Upkeep phases. Noon Job, Boot: Mark an opposing dude. If successful, you may ace this dude to ace the mark.

name: Articulated Reloading Manager
text: A dude cannot have more than one Articulated Reloading Manager attached. Noon/Shootout, Boot: Unboot another goods attached to this dude. Its abilities may be used an additional time this turn.

name: Colt-Patterson Model '36
text: Shootout, Boot: Give this dude +2 Bullets and make them a Stud.

name: Whistle Stop
text: Shootout: Discard this card. All opposing dudes get -1 bullets. Pull. if the pull is ♣, all of your dudes get -1 bullets.

name: Kentucky Windage
text: Shoutout Hex 5, Boot: This Huckster becomes a stud. Shootout Hex 6, Boot: This Huckster gains +1 bullets.

name: 54 Card Pick-Up
text: Shootout Hex 7, Boot: Boot an Opposing Dude. Shootout Hex 11, Boot: Boot two Opposing Cards.

name: Turn the Other Cheek
text: Shootout Miracle X, Boot: Target an opposing dude. X is that dude's grit. If successful, send them and this Blessed home. Unboot both dudes.

name: Cloak
text: React Miracle 5, Boot: When this dude would go home booted for refusing a callout, they don't boot and stay at their location instead.

name: Mountain Lion's Den
text: Shootout Spirirt 6, Boot: Each dude in your posse gets +1 bullets and cannot have their bullets reduced or changed to a draw by other players' card effects.

name: Stoic Buffalo
text: Shootout Spirit 9: For this shootout round, after each time you pass as your Shootout play, you may draw a card.

name: Like a Bull...
text: Cheatin' Resolution: The cheatin' player either pays 1 ghost rock or discards a random card. If this is a shootout, reduce your casualties by 1. Resolution: If this shootout is at a deed, boot the deed. It does not provide control points or production until after the next Upkeep phase.

name: Mind of Quicksilver
text: Shootout Technique: Unboot this dude. Add the pulled card to your hand. Noon Technique: Draw a card.

name: One-Eyed Jacks are Wild
text: Cheatin' Resolution: You may change the value and suit of one card in your draw hand. Your new hand is considered legal. If this is the Gamblin' Phase, draw a card.

name: Puttin' On Airs
text: Noon: Your target dude gets +1 influence. You may remove a bounty from them. That dude cannot make callouts or join the leader's posse.

name: Ready Fer Anythin'
text: Noon: Target your dude. If that dude has a Sidekick, they get +1 influence. If they have a Weapon, draw a card. If they have an Attire, they become a stud. If they have a Horse, they get +1 bullets.

name: Debt of Blood
text: Shootout: If one of your dudes has been discarded or aced this turn, either as a casualty or by an opposing card effect, give your target dude +3 bullets and make them a stud. Noon: If one of your dudes has been aced this turn, either as a casualty or by an opposing card effect, give your target dude +3 bullets and make them a stud.

name: Suppressing Fire
text: Shootout: Make an opposing booted dude a draw. Shootout: Boot one of your dudes or their attached Weapon to make them a stud.

name: Any Port in a Storm
text: React: When your dude would go home booted from refusing a callout, during the "Flight or Fight" step of a shootout, or while resolving a successful job, instead move that dude booted to another in-town deed you own. You may pay 1 ghost rock to unboot that dude.

name: Fort 51
text: React: After you invent a Gadget Weapon or Gadget dude, give 1 bounty to an opposing dude with influence equal to or less than the Gadget's printed cost. Noon, Boot: Boot your Gadget that is not at your home and remove 1 bounty from an opposing dude. Gain 1 ghost rock and you may discard a card.

name: Wong Fee Lee
text: While you have dudes in a shootout, Wong has +1 Kung Fu for each dude in the opposing posse (even when Wong is not in the posse).

name: Mr. Outang
text: Noon: Call out a dude at this Saloon. Shootout: Boot a Saloon you control to give Mr. Outang +1 bullets.

name: Piotr
text: Shootout Repeat: Discard Piotr's Miracle to give him +1 bullets and make him a stud. You may use this ability once per shootout.

name: Pianogeist
text: While Pianogeist is at an opponent's home, it has -1 upkeep. Noon: Move Pianogeist to the home of a player with more ghost rock than you. You may boot a dude there.

name: Sterling Chan
text: Noon, Boot: Target a dude at this location. If they are in the same location as Sterling this Nightfall, they do not unboot.

name: Delores "Dolly" Lassiter
text: Noon, Pay 1 Ghost Rock: Unboot this deed. Its abilities may be used an additional time this turn.

name: Dr. Dwight Shelton
text: Noon, Boot: If this location is a Ranch, search your discard pile for a non-Gadget Horse, add it to your play hand, then discard a card.

name: Noah & Jonah Whateley
text: While in a shootout at your home, Hucksters in a posse with Noah & Jonah are studs.

name: The Grave Gunslinger
text: You may play the Gunslinger from your hand (into your posse) as a Shootout play (paying all costs). He enters the shootout booted. Resolution, Boot: Put the Gunslinger into your draw hand, he becomes the suit and value of your choice. Discard a card from your draw hand.

name: Gabrielle Perivale
text: Shootout: Boot Gabrielle's Mystical goods to reduce an opposing dude's bullets and influence by Gabrielle's bullets and influence, respectively.

name: The Resurrectionist
text: React: After the Resurrectionist enters play, shuffle an Abomination from your Boot Hill into your deck.

name: Jett Can Cega
text: React Repeat: Before Jett leaves your posse, boot a card in the opposing posse.

name: Fire-Dancer
text: React: After Fire-Dancer succeeds with a pull to activate a Totem, unboot him.

name: Mahpiya Violet
text: Shootout: Discard a Spirit you own at this location (attached to a dude or planted here) to give Mahpiya +2 bullets and make her a stud.

name: Uncle Howard Bearclaw
text: Noon: Move Uncle to an Out of Town location.

name: Rafi Hamid
text: Noon: Move Rafi to a Government location. React: After a dude in the opposing posse is aced, Rafi gets a permanent +1 bullets.

name: Iris Jarvis
text: Resolution: Boot an opposing wanted dude. If your opponent has a cheatin' hand, you may boot an opposing card.

name: Nat Wright
text: Noon: Boot Nat's Melee Weapon to call out a wanted dude at this location.

name: Petunia Mallard
text: While in a shootout, Petunia gets a bonus to influence equal to the highest bullets among dudes in her posse.

name: Mateo Suarez
text: React: After Mateo gains bounty, draw a card.

name: Abigail Lloyd
text: Resolution: If you revealed a cheatin' hand, discard a goods or spell in the opposing posse.

name: Harry Highbinder
text: Harry may not have attached goods.  While Harry is in town square, town square can be controlled by players and is worth 1 control point.

name: Len Nuanez
text: React: After Len successfully invents a Gadget Weapon, attach it to a nearby dude (ignoring control of the location and the dude being booted). React: After Len successfully invents an Experimental Gadget, unboot him.

name: Tsurugi
text: While Tsurugi has a Melee Weapon, he gets +2 bullets.

name: Blind Mary
text: While Mary has a Gadget Sidekick, she is a stud. Shootout: Boot a Gadget attached to Mary to give her +1 bullets.

name: Calamity Jane
text: Shootout Repeat: Discard a ♣ to give an opposing dude -2 bullets. You may use this ability once per shootout.

name: Doris Powell
text: At the end of the turn, or if Doris is ever at home, she loses all control points.  Whenever Doris moves to an in-town deed without booting, she  gains a control point, to a maximum of 3.

name: Red Tears
text: React: After a Totem is planted at this location, gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Empire Bakery
text: React, Boot: During the Upkeep phase, one of your dudes at this deed gets -1 upkeep.

name: Bai Long Tea Shop
text: Noon, Boot: Move a zero influence dude from an adjacent location to this deed.

name: Dr. Babcock's Office
text: React, Boot: When discarding (not acing) a dude to cover casualties, place them in your hand instead (only applies to one dude if multiple dudes are being discarded).

name: Scout's Rest Ranch
text: Noon, Boot: Move your dude with a Horse home (from any location).

name: Langrishe Theater
text: Abominations at this location have -1 bullets.

name: Iron Dragon Regional Office
text: After the Gamblin' phase, this deed's controller discards a card at random.

name: Wong's Bazaar
text: Cheatin' Resolution, Boot: Take 1 ghost rock from the cheatin' player or draw a card.

name: Sunday Best
text: This dude gets +3 influence during the Production phase. React, Boot: At the start of the Production phase, move this dude to an adjacent location (without booting).

name: Guandao
text: If this dude has Kung Fu, they become a stud. Shootout, Boot: This dude gets +1 bullets.

name: Steel Swarm
text: Cheatin' Resolution, Boot: The cheatin' player must boot one of their dudes. If this is a shootout, reduce your casualties by 2 this round and boot an opposing dude.

name: Log-o-Matic
text: Shootout, Boot: If this isn't the first round of the shootout, your opponent takes an extra casualty this round.

name: Penny Farthing
text: This dude gets +1 influence while in town square. Noon, Boot: Discard a card to move this dude to an adjacent location.

name: Negentropic Pylon
text: Negentropic Pylon is worth 1 control point while at an opponent's home.    At Sundown, pull. If the pull is ♣, discard this card.

name: The Royals' Hoyle
text: Cheatin' Resolution, Boot: The cheatin' player discards a card from their play hand. If this is a shootout, reduce your casualties by 1. If this dude is a Huckster, draw a card.

name: Dingler's Dirigible
text: Noon, Boot: Target another location. Move any number of your dudes from this location to there. If the pull is ♣, boot all of your dudes that moved.

name: Clear Out!
text: Noon Hex X, Boot: Target an opposing dude at this location. X is that dude's grit. If successful, send them home. If successful by 6 or more, boot them.

name: Alone in the Dark
text: Shootout Hex X, Boot: Target an opposing dude. X is that dude's grit. If successful, that dude does not contribute to draw hands and cannot be chosen as a casualty this round. If all dudes in a posse are ever affected by Alone in the Dark, cancel the effect on each of those dudes.

name: Chastise
text: Noon Miracle 9, Boot: A wanted dude at a nearby location gets -1 influence and -1 bullets.

name: Strength of Fellowship
text: Shootout Miracle 8, Boot: Boot any number of dudes in your posse to make them studs.

name: Vengeful Pack
text: Resolution Spirit 5, Boot: If this Sidekick is discarded to cover casualties this round, a 2-stud Gunslinger token joins your posse.

name: Bones of the Earth
text: Dudes may not be sent home from shootouts at this location. Shootout Spirit 6, Boot: All non-Shaman dudes in this shootout get -1 bullets.

name: Inner Struggle
text: While this card is booted, reduce your shootout hand rank by 1. If you reveal a cheatin' hand during a shootout and the owner of this card has a legal hand, boot this card. Cheatin' Resolution: Attach this card to the cheatin' player's home, booted. That player discards one random card from their play hand.

name: Hickok's Revenge
text: Resolution: A 2-stud Gunslinger token enters play and joins your posse. If the opponent's hand is a Dead Man's Hand, reduce the cost of this card by 2, reduce your casualties by 3 this round, and give the Gunslinger +2 bullets.

name: On the Lam
text: Noon: Increase the bounty of a dude by 1. The dude's controller may move them to another location.

name: My Horse Don't Like Ya, Either
text: Noon: Boot your dude's Horse to have that dude call out a dude at their location with lower value than the Horse.

name: I'll Cover Yer Backs!
text: Resolution: Boot your target dude to send up to two of your dudes home booted. You may unboot one of the sent home dudes with grit lower than the target's.

name: Unexpected Allies
text: Cheatin' Resolution: Choose a dude from your discard pile and add that dude to your play hand. If this is a shootout, you may have that dude join your posse (paying all costs) to increase your hand rank by 2.

name: Facing Yer Demons
text: Noon: Target your dude with no attached cards. Give them +2 bullets. When the target calls out a dude, the mark's controller must discard a card as an additional cost to refuse the callout. (These effects still apply even if the target attaches cards later this turn.)

name: STAMPEDE!
text: Noon Job, Boot: Mark the town square. If successful, boot all dudes in town square, and it is not considered adjacent to in-town locations this turn.

name: Against the Odds
text: Shootout: You get +1 hand rank this round if the opposing posse has more dudes than your posse when draw hands are revealed.

name: Stand Together
text: Shootout: Target your unbooted dude in the shootout to unboot a number of your dudes equal to the target dude's influence.
